english: Kiradu, once called Kiratakupa, lies in the Thar Desert of western Rajasthan. Its carved temples recall the small dynasties that governed here as vassals of the Chaulukya rulers of Gujarat. In the twelfth century authority passed among a Paramara branch, the Naddula Chahamanas, and other dependents of the same overlords. At least five temple ruins survive, including sanctuaries of Shiva and Vishnu; the Someshvara temple retains richly sculpted walls and an octagonal arrangement of hall columns. The buildings are associated with the Maru-Gurjara architectural tradition, although scholars differ over their exact dates. An inscription of 1178 records repairs to a temple damaged by Turkic attackers, generally identified with the Ghurid forces defeated at Kasahrada.
simp_chinese: 吉罗菟旧名基拉塔库帕，位于拉贾斯坦西部的塔尔沙漠。当地雕饰繁密的寺庙，见证了臣服于古吉拉特遮娄其王朝的各个小王朝。十二世纪时，统治权先后在波罗摩罗的一支、纳杜拉的遮诃摩那家族及同一宗主的其他附庸之间转移。至少五处寺庙遗迹留存至今，包括湿婆与毗湿奴的神殿；保存较完整的苏摩湿伐罗寺仍有精雕墙面，殿厅柱列呈八角形排列。建筑属于摩卢—古吉拉风格传统，但学者对确切年代存在分歧。1178年的一方铭文记录了修复遭突厥人破坏的寺庙，这些袭击者通常被认为是后来在卡萨赫拉达战败的古尔军队。

english: Kirando lies in the Nkasi country of western Rukwa beside Lake Tanganyika. Across the wider district, fishing, livestock and subsistence cultivation support rural communities. Maize, millet, beans and cassava are important crops, while the lake links this shore with Congo to the west.
simp_chinese: 基兰多位于鲁夸西部、坦噶尼喀湖畔的恩卡西地区。在更广阔区域，捕鱼、畜牧与自给农业支撑乡村社群。玉米、小米、豆类和木薯是重要作物，湖泊将此岸同西面的刚果相连。

english: Kirarutah belongs to the mixed-grass prairie country of the Central Great Plains. This wider grassland belt runs from Nebraska through Kansas and western Oklahoma into Texas, between the taller eastern prairies and shorter western grasslands.
simp_chinese: 基拉鲁塔属于中部大平原的混合草草原地区。这片广阔草原带从内布拉斯加经堪萨斯与俄克拉荷马西部延伸至得克萨斯，处于东部高草草原与西部矮草草原之间。

english:
Kirchdorf an der Krems occupies a small riverside site in Upper Austria. Settlement here is reported as early as 903, although the date is uncertain. The Krems gives the town its distinguishing name among the many German-speaking places called Kirchdorf.

The later town remained compact, covering about three square kilometers. In the nineteenth century it was the birthplace of the chemist Josef Redtenbacher and the physician and entomologist Ludwig Redtenbacher, linking this small Upper Austrian community with the expanding natural sciences.
simp_chinese:
克雷姆斯河畔基希多夫位于上奥地利一处面积不大的河滨地带。据称这里早在903年已有聚落，不过这一年代尚不确定。克雷姆斯河也使它能与德语地区其他名叫基希多夫的地方相区别。

后来形成的城镇仍十分紧凑，面积约三平方公里。十九世纪，这里先后诞生了化学家约瑟夫·雷滕巴赫尔，以及医生兼昆虫学家路德维希·雷滕巴赫尔，将这个上奥地利小社区与不断发展的自然科学联系起来。

english: Kiri-Kerê belongs to the Aimoré country of eastern Brazil. The wider people occupied lands from Espírito Santo toward the headwaters of the Doce and Belmonte rivers, and were called Botocudo by the Portuguese for the wooden disks worn in lips and ears.
simp_chinese: 基里凯雷属于巴西东部艾莫雷地区。更广阔的族群生活于圣埃斯皮里图至多西河、贝尔蒙特河源流地区，因唇耳所佩木盘被葡萄牙人称为博托库多人。

english: Kirikongo's earthen mounds preserve the history of an Iron Age community in the Mouhoun Bend. Occupation began around the first century CE and continued into the seventeenth century; thirteen mounds spread across some thirty-seven hectares, many marking former households. Early houses had clay floors, and their occupants smelted iron and made grinding stones for agricultural work. Over time, changes in building, burial and pottery reveal a society in which lineage and specialised skills acquired greater importance. Around the eleventh century, ceramic production became more specialised, while a ritual building has been interpreted as an ancestor house where goods were stored and animals sacrificed. Unlike some northern settlements, Kirikongo offers relatively little evidence of long-distance trade, directing attention to its own farming, herding and household life.
simp_chinese: 基里孔戈的土丘保存着穆翁河曲一处铁器时代社群的历史。这里约在公元一世纪开始有人居住，一直延续至十七世纪；十三座土丘分布于约三十七公顷土地上，许多对应昔日的家庭住区。早期房屋铺有黏土地面，居民冶炼铁器，并制作加工农产的磨石。此后，建筑、墓葬与陶器的变化反映出一个逐渐重视家系和专业技能的社会。十一世纪前后，制陶更趋专业化，一座具有仪式性质的建筑被解释为存放物品、举行动物献祭的祖先屋。与一些北方聚落相比，基里孔戈的远距离贸易证据较少，其自身的耕作、牧养与家庭生活因此更引人注意。

english: Kirillov grew around the Kirillo-Belozersky Monastery, founded beside Lake Siverskoye in 1397 by Cyril of White Lake. The area had belonged to the Principality of Beloozero before passing to Moscow. The monastery became one of Russia’s most influential religious landholders.
simp_chinese: 基里洛夫兴起于白湖基里尔修道院周围，该院由白湖的基里尔于1397年建立在西韦尔斯科耶湖旁。此地曾属别洛奥泽罗公国，后归莫斯科。修道院成为俄罗斯最有影响力的宗教地主之一。

english: Kirina is remembered for the victory that established the ascendancy of Sundiata Keita's Mali. Around 1235, a coalition gathered by the exiled Mandinka prince met the forces of the Sosso ruler Sumanguru Kanté in the country now called Koulikoro. Sundiata's victory was followed by an advance against Sosso and is conventionally treated as the foundation of the Mali Empire. The battle also lives in the Epic of Sundiata, where political conflict becomes a struggle against a sorcerer-king. Its tale of a rooster-spur arrow belongs to that epic tradition, preserving a different kind of memory alongside the contest for rule in the Upper Niger country.
simp_chinese: 基里纳因奠定松迪亚塔·凯塔及其马里霸权的胜利而留名。约1235年，这位流亡的曼丁卡王子召集诸国联盟，在如今称作库利科罗的地区迎战索索统治者苏曼古鲁·坎特。松迪亚塔获胜后继续向索索进军，这场战役通常被视为马里帝国的开端。它也流传于《松迪亚塔史诗》中，政治冲突在其中化为对抗巫术国王的斗争。公鸡距箭头的故事属于这一史诗传统，在上尼日尔地区争夺统治权的历史之外，保存着另一种记忆。

english: Kirira belongs to the wider Lunda sphere of central Africa. The Lunda commonwealth's core lay in Katanga, with affiliated states extending into Angola and Zambia. Its political traditions preserved links with the Luba and the office of a queen mother known as Rukonkesh.
simp_chinese: 基里拉属于中非更广阔的隆达势力范围。隆达共同体的核心位于加丹加，附属诸国延伸至安哥拉与赞比亚。其政治传统保留着同卢巴的联系，以及称为鲁孔凯什的王母职位。

english: Kiriras belongs to the wider Tocantins and Araguaia country of central Brazil. The region combines cerrado with Amazonian environments, and its great rivers create watered corridors through otherwise drier landscapes.
simp_chinese: 基里拉斯属于巴西中部更广阔的托坎廷斯河与阿拉瓜亚河地区。这里兼有塞拉多与亚马孙环境，大河在较干燥的土地间形成水源充沛的走廊。

english: Kiriri belongs to the wider Itapicuru country of Bahia in northeastern Brazil. The regional namesake survives as a municipality in that state, linking this locality to the inland geography of the Brazilian Northeast.
simp_chinese: 基里里属于巴西东北部巴伊亚州更广阔的伊塔皮库鲁地区。地区同名市镇至今仍隶属该州，将这里与巴西东北部的内陆地理联系起来。

english:
Kiritimati is a great coral atoll of the northern Line Islands, with a broad lagoon broken into smaller lagoons, salt ponds and tidal flats. Archaeological remains place human use of the island between about 1250 and 1450. Habitation sites, marae and canoe shelters cluster along the eastern shore; some researchers interpret the alternating traces of occupation as evidence of intermittent visits to gather birds, turtles and other resources.

The Spanish expedition of Hernando de Grijalva charted the island as Acea in 1537. James Cook reached it on Christmas Eve in 1777, and Christmas Island became the name later rendered in Gilbertese as Kiritimati. Whalers called from at least 1822, but lasting modern settlement began only in 1882, with plantation labourers and fishermen. Its earlier history therefore belongs as much to ocean voyaging and temporary resource gathering as to permanent village life.
simp_chinese:
基里蒂马蒂是莱恩群岛北部的一座大型珊瑚环礁，宽广的潟湖逐渐分成较小的水域、盐池与潮滩。考古遗存表明，约1250至1450年间已有人在岛上活动。居址、马拉埃祭祀场与舟棚集中在东岸；一些研究者将时断时续的居住痕迹解释为定期来访，采集海鸟、海龟及其他资源的证据。

埃尔南多·德·格里哈尔瓦率领的西班牙探险队于1537年将此岛绘入海图，称为阿塞阿。詹姆斯·库克在1777年圣诞前夜抵达，圣诞岛之名后来以吉尔伯特语写作基里蒂马蒂。至少从1822年起便有捕鲸船到访，但持久的现代定居直到1882年才由种植园劳工与渔民开启。因此，更早的岛屿历史既包含村落生活，也与远洋航行及暂住采集密切相关。

english: Kiritimati is a great raised coral atoll of the northern Line Islands, where low land encloses a maze of lagoons, salt ponds and tidal flats. Excavated hearths, habitation sites and marae show Polynesian use between about 1250 and 1450; some scholars interpret the alternating layers in the hearths as evidence of intermittent visits to gather birds and turtles. A Spanish expedition charted the atoll in 1537, and James Cook called there on Christmas Eve in 1777, giving rise to the name later rendered as Kiritimati in Gilbertese. Whalers visited from at least 1822. Permanent settlement followed much later, beginning in 1882 with plantation workers and fishermen, while severe drought remained a powerful limit on life upon the porous coral ground.
simp_chinese: 圣诞岛环礁是莱恩群岛北部一座广大的隆起珊瑚环礁，低矮陆地围绕着交错的潟湖、盐池与潮滩。出土火塘、居址与祭祀场所显示，波利尼西亚人约在1250至1450年间曾利用此岛；一些学者将火塘中交替出现的土层，解释为人们间歇来此捕取鸟类与海龟的证据。西班牙探险队于1537年将环礁绘入海图，詹姆斯·库克则在1777年圣诞节前夕到访，由此产生的名称后来按吉尔伯特语拼写为 Kiritimati。至少从1822年起，捕鲸船便曾来访。永久聚居到1882年才由种植园工人与渔民开启，而多孔的珊瑚地面和严重旱灾始终约束着岛上生活。

english: Kiritimati’s waters surround a large coral atoll in the northern Line Islands. Its broad land surface and network of lagoons lie just north of the equator, far south of Hawaii.
simp_chinese: 基里蒂马蒂周边水域环绕北莱恩群岛的一座大型珊瑚环礁。宽广陆地与相互联系的潟湖位于赤道以北不远，远在夏威夷以南。

english:
Kirkcudbright stands at the mouth of Galloway's River Dee, a harbour whose name recalls the chapel of Saint Cuthbert. The Gaelic Cille Chuithbeirt lies behind its older form, Kilcudbrit. The town became a royal burgh in 1455, and in 1461 the defeated Henry VI of England landed here after crossing the Solway Firth on his way into Scottish exile. Its position also exposed it to invasion: English forces besieged it in 1547 and compelled its surrender after overrunning the surrounding country.

Religious and civic buildings record later changes within the burgh. Around 1570 Sir Thomas MacLellan acquired the former convent site and dismantled its church for material to build his castle. The tolbooth, erected between 1625 and 1629, gathered government, justice and confinement under one roof, housing council offices, courts and prisons for criminals and debtors.
simp_chinese:
柯库布里坐落于加洛韦的迪河河口，是一座名称纪念圣卡斯伯特礼拜堂的港镇。其早期拼写Kilcudbrit源自盖尔语Cille Chuithbeirt。1455年，城镇获得皇家自治市地位；1461年，战败的英王亨利六世渡过索尔韦湾在此登陆，踏上流亡苏格兰的道路。这一位置也使城镇暴露于入侵：1547年，英军围攻这里，在占领周围乡野后迫使其投降。

宗教与市政建筑记下了自治市内部后来的变化。约1570年，托马斯·麦克莱伦爵士取得旧修道院地块，拆除教堂，利用石材建造自己的城堡。1625至1629年间修建的市政监狱大楼，则将行政、司法与拘禁汇聚一处，既设议事机构和法庭，也关押刑事犯与债务人。

english: The northern Queensland coastal world is home to many Aboriginal language communities. The Yadhaykenu speak a variety of Uradhi, related to neighbouring dialects of the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 昆士兰北部沿海世界生活着众多原住民语言社群。亚达伊加纳人使用乌拉迪语的一种变体，与半岛邻近方言相关。

english: The headland now called Kirkenes projects into Bøkfjorden, an arm of Varangerfjorden opening towards the Barents Sea. Around four hundred kilometres north of the Arctic Circle, it experiences long periods of midnight sun and polar night, while pine and birch mark the northern taiga landscape. The surrounding district was shared between Norway and Russia until the frontier settlement of 1826. The peninsula was earlier known as Piselvnes, or the Pis River headland. Its present name, meaning church headland, followed the construction of a church in 1862, well after the era when this was an unsettled border district.
simp_chinese: 如今名为希尔克内斯的岬角伸入伯克峡湾，这是瓦朗厄尔峡湾的一条支汊，通向巴伦支海。这里位于北极圈以北约四百公里，经历漫长的极昼与极夜，松树和桦树则标示着北方泰加林的景观。周围地区曾由挪威与俄罗斯共同管辖，直到1826年才划定边界。半岛早先名为皮瑟尔夫内斯，意为皮斯河岬角。如今意为教堂岬角的名称，得自1862年建起的教堂，已是这片边地划界之后的事。

english: Kirkjubaejar belongs to the eastern country of Iceland. Across the island, glacial rivers descend from a volcanic interior to the lowlands, and medieval accounts recall Christian monks called Papar before the arrival of Scandinavian settlers.
simp_chinese: 克劳斯图尔属于冰岛东部。在全岛范围内，冰川河流从火山内陆流向低地，中世纪记述则提到斯堪的纳维亚移民抵达以前曾有被称为帕帕尔的基督教修士。

english: Known to Byzantine Greeks as Saranta Ekklisies, or Forty Churches, Kırklareli retained the same meaning in its Ottoman name of Kırk Kilise. The settlement changed hands between Bulgarians and Byzantines before Ottoman forces took it under Murad I in 1363. Twenty years later, Köse Mihalzade Hızır Bey founded a mosque and bath complex in the town centre. The adjoining covered bazaar contained twelve shops beneath a vaulted roof, binding worship, bathing and commerce into a single urban ensemble. Its present name, Kırklareli, was officially adopted only in 1924.
simp_chinese: 拜占庭希腊人称克尔克拉雷利为萨兰塔埃克利西斯，意为“四十座教堂”，奥斯曼时期的名称克尔克基利塞延续了同一含义。聚落曾在保加利亚与拜占庭之间易手，1363年由穆拉德一世治下的奥斯曼军队夺取。二十年后，克塞·米哈尔之子赫兹尔贝伊在城中心建立清真寺与浴场建筑群。相邻的有顶市场在拱顶下设有十二间店铺，将礼拜、沐浴与商业汇集在同一组城市建筑中。如今的克尔克拉雷利之名直到1924年才获正式采用。

english: Kirkuk stands beside the Khasa River around its old citadel, on the site associated with ancient Arrapha. The city passed through Assyrian, Seleucid, Parthian and Sasanian rule, while its surrounding district was known in Syriac sources as Beth Garmai. Under the Sasanians it became an important centre of the Church of the East, giving the city a religious history as layered as its fortifications. Arab conquest brought it into the caliphate, followed in later centuries by Kurdish dynasties, Seljuks and Mongols. The Mongols took the city in 1258, and it became part of the Ilkhanate. Kurds, Turkmens, Arabs and Assyrians have all contributed to the varied life of this northern Mesopotamian city.
simp_chinese: 基尔库克位于哈萨河畔，城镇环绕古老的城堡展开，其位置与古代阿拉法相联系。这里历经亚述、塞琉古、帕提亚和萨珊诸王朝统治，周边地区在叙利亚语文献中被称为贝特加尔迈。萨珊时期，城市成为东方教会的重要中心，其宗教历史与城防遗迹一样层层积累。阿拉伯征服将它纳入哈里发国，后来又先后经历库尔德王朝、塞尔柱人和蒙古人的统治。1258年蒙古军队占领城市，随后这里成为伊儿汗国的一部分。库尔德人、土库曼人、阿拉伯人和亚述人共同构成了这座北美索不达米亚城市多样的生活。

english: Kirovskiy belongs to the western Kamchatkan country beside the Sea of Okhotsk. The wider peninsula contains a remarkable chain of volcanoes forming part of the Pacific Ring of Fire.
simp_chinese: 基洛夫斯基属于鄂霍次克海畔的堪察加西部地区。更广阔的半岛拥有醒目的火山链，构成环太平洋火山带的一部分。

english: Kirs belongs to the wider Omutninsk country of the Vyatka region. The modern regional center lies in Kirov Oblast and first appears in records in 1773; it later became the administrative focus of surrounding rural localities.
simp_chinese: 基尔斯属于维亚特卡地区更广阔的奥穆特宁斯克地域。现代地区中心位于基洛夫州，1773年首次见于记载，后来成为周边乡村的行政中心。

english: Kirsanov stands east of Tambov where the Pursovka joins the Vorona River. The settlement of Kirsanovo is said to have been founded in the first half of the seventeenth century and named after an early settler, Kirsan Zubakin. It gained town status in 1779, placing its urban development firmly within the later imperial period. A further transformation came well after the age of its foundation: in 1875 the railway linking Tambov and Saratov passed through Kirsanov, connecting this river settlement to a much wider transport network.
simp_chinese: 基尔萨诺夫位于坦波夫以东，普尔索夫卡河在此汇入沃罗纳河。据当地建城叙述，基尔萨诺沃聚落形成于17世纪上半叶，名称来自早期定居者基尔桑·祖巴金。1779年，它获得城镇地位，城市发展的重要阶段由此属于帝俄时期。建城很久以后，新的变化再次到来：1875年，连接坦波夫与萨拉托夫的铁路经过基尔萨诺夫，将这座河流聚落接入更广阔的交通网络。

english: Kırşehir rises on the central Anatolian plateau, its Turkish name meaning “steppe city.” The Seljuks took the town in the 1070s and gave it this name. Their presence also survives in Kesikköprü, the bridge across the Kızılırmak south of the town: its thirteen spans carried travellers on the road toward Konya and the routes linking western Anatolia to Sivas and Erzurum. An inscription dates its construction to 1248. In later centuries its name, the “Cut Bridge,” was associated with caravan roads interrupted by highwaymen. Kırşehir also preserves the mausoleum of Aşık Pasha, the Sufi poet who died in 1332, joining the memory of religious verse to that of roads and rulers.
simp_chinese: 克尔谢希尔坐落在安纳托利亚中部高原，土耳其语城名意为“草原之城”。塞尔柱人在11世纪70年代夺取城镇，并赋予它这个名称。他们的遗迹还见于城南横跨克泽勒河的凯西克桥：十三孔桥身承载着通往科尼亚的旅人，也连接安纳托利亚西部与锡瓦斯、埃尔祖鲁姆之间的道路。铭文将其修建时间定为1248年。后世“断桥”之名被联系到遭强盗截断的商队道路。城中还保存着1332年去世的苏菲诗人阿希克帕夏的陵墓，使宗教诗歌的记忆与道路、统治者的往事交织在一起。

english: The Kirthar Mountains form a long barrier between the Indus country of Sindh and the highlands of Balochistan. Their parallel ridges run mainly north and south, broken by dry valleys and drained in part by the Gaj and Hub rivers. From the Mula River the range stretches roughly three hundred kilometres south toward Cape Monze and the Arabian Sea. This rugged country has a long human history: prehistoric sites lie within it, and the Taung Tombs date from the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries. Sindhi and Balochi communities have maintained flocks among the hills, while passes such as Gaji Lak provide routes across the ridges.
simp_chinese: 基尔塔尔山脉在信德的印度河地区与俾路支高地之间形成绵长屏障。大致南北走向的平行山岭之间夹着干燥谷地，部分水流汇入加杰河与胡布河。山脉自穆拉河向南延伸约三百公里，直至阿拉伯海畔的蒙兹角。这片崎岖之地有着悠久的人类活动史：山中分布着史前遗址，陶恩墓群则建于16至18世纪。信德与俾路支社群在山间放牧，而加吉拉克等山口为穿越重重山岭提供了道路。

english:
The Kirthar Mountains rise along the western side of Sindh, forming a rugged division between the Indus country and the Iranian plateau. Parallel ridges run mainly north to south, with dry riverbeds and narrow plains lying between them. Limestone caps much of the higher ground, while the Gaj and Hub rivers drain parts of the range.

Several passes cross the hills, including Gaji Lak on the route linking Zidi and Khuzdar with Jhalawan. Sindhi and Baloch communities have long used the mountain country for flock grazing. Prehistoric sites and the Taung tombs, dating from the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries, give the wider range a human history beyond its bare ridges and seasonal streams.
simp_chinese:
基尔塔尔山脉耸立于信德西侧，在印度河地区与伊朗高原之间形成崎岖的分界。平行山脊大体南北延伸，其间夹着干涸河床和狭窄平原。高处多见石灰岩，盖杰河与胡布河则排泄山脉部分地区的径流。

山间存在数条通道，其中加吉拉克山口位于连接济迪、胡兹达尔与贾拉万的路线上。信德和俾路支各社群长期在山地放牧。史前遗址以及建于16至18世纪的陶恩格墓群，显示这片广大山脉除了裸露的山脊和季节性溪流，也保存着丰富的人类活动痕迹。

english: Kirzhach grew beside its namesake river as a settlement attached to the Annunciation Monastery. Saint Sergius of Radonezh founded the religious house in the fourteenth century and lived in this area between 1354 and 1358. The monastery long remained dependent on the Trinity monastery to the west, linking the small river settlement with one of Muscovy's great spiritual centres. Its compact cathedral was erected during the reign of Ivan the Terrible, while the nearby Saviour church became a burial place of the Miloslavsky boyars. After the monastery was dissolved in 1764, Kirzhach received town rights in 1778 and developed into a textile centre, adding manufactures to a landscape previously shaped by monastic estates.
simp_chinese: 基尔扎奇在同名河流旁兴起，最初是隶属于圣母领报修道院的聚落。拉多涅日的圣谢尔吉于十四世纪建立这座宗教机构，并在1354至1358年间居住于此。修道院长期依附于西面的圣三一修道院，将小小的河畔聚落与莫斯科公国的重要宗教中心连接起来。院内体量不大的主教堂建于伊凡雷帝时期，附近的救世主教堂则成为米洛斯拉夫斯基波雅尔家族的墓葬地。修道院于1764年解散后，基尔扎奇在1778年获得城市权，继而发展为纺织中心，为此前由修道院地产塑造的地方增添了制造业。

english: Kisakaba belongs to the wider Kwango country of southwestern Congo. The region takes its name from the Kwango River, a Kasai tributary that forms part of the frontier with Angola.
simp_chinese: 基萨卡巴处于刚果西南部广义的宽果地区。整个区域因宽果河得名，这条开赛河支流构成与安哥拉边界的一部分。

english: Kisatchie belongs to the wider Louisiana country on the Gulf of Mexico. The region’s French heritage remains visible in its parish divisions, while the Mississippi basin links it to the continental interior.
simp_chinese: 基萨奇属于墨西哥湾沿岸的路易斯安那地区。当地以堂区划分行政区域，保留了法国传统的痕迹，密西西比流域则将其与大陆内地相连。

english: Kisenga belongs to the wider Viye historical world. The kingdom was ruled by a king and subordinate nobles, whose competing ambitions shaped its politics during the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 基森加属于更广阔的维耶历史区域。该王国由国王与属下贵族统治，十八世纪末至十九世纪初，他们相互竞争的雄心影响着当地政治。

english: Kisenge lies in southern Congo near the Angolan border, surrounded by tropical forest. Its population has connections across that frontier. Migration following Angolan independence in 1975 helped spread Portuguese alongside local Bantu languages and French.
simp_chinese: 基森格位于刚果南部、安哥拉边境附近，周围分布热带森林。当地人口与边境另一侧联系密切。1975年安哥拉独立后的移民，使葡萄牙语在当地班图语言和法语之外进一步传播。

english: Kish belongs to the wider Persian Gulf trading world associated with Siraf. Ships linked this coast with Arabia and India, while small dhows could make long voyages by following the shoreline.
simp_chinese: 基什属于与锡拉夫相联系的更广阔波斯湾贸易区域。船舶将这一海岸与阿拉伯及印度连接起来，小型独桅帆船也能沿海岸完成长途航行。

english: The waters around Kish lie off the southern Persian coast, with the island only about nineteen kilometres from the mainland. Its low, nearly oval shoreline extends for roughly forty kilometres into the Persian Gulf. The island appears in ancient accounts under names including Arakata, associated with the voyage of Nearchus in 325 BC. Centuries later, Marco Polo linked the pearls of Kish with the ornaments of the Chinese empress. On the northern shore, the remains of Harireh preserve a settlement dating to the eighth century, a reminder that the island's human history long predates its modern resorts.
simp_chinese: 基什岛周边水域位于波斯南部海岸外，岛屿距大陆仅约十九公里。它近乎椭圆的低平海岸线长约四十公里，横卧于波斯湾中。古代记述曾以阿拉卡塔等名称提及此岛，并将其与公元前325年尼阿卡斯的航行联系起来。许多个世纪后，马可·波罗将基什的珍珠与中国皇后的饰物相联系。北岸的哈里雷遗址保留了一处可追溯至八世纪的聚落，见证岛上的人类历史远早于现代度假设施。

english: Kish, now Shahrisabz, stands south of Samarkand in the ancient land of Sogdiana. It was an important urban centre under the Achaemenid Empire and is among Central Asia’s oldest cities. Its later fame is inseparable from Timur, the fourteenth-century conqueror born in this region.
simp_chinese: 渴石即今日沙赫里萨布兹，位于撒马尔罕以南的古粟特地区。它在阿契美尼德帝国时期已是重要城市，也是中亚最古老的城市之一。后来其声名与十四世纪征服者帖木儿密不可分，帖木儿便诞生于这一带。

english: Kishi belongs to Awadh, a northern Indian region governed by several major Islamic dynasties. In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, its nawabs supported literature, religion, art and architecture, with the capital eventually moving to Lucknow.
simp_chinese: 基希属于印度北部的奥德地区，多个主要伊斯兰王朝曾在此设治。十八至十九世纪，奥德纳瓦卜资助文学、宗教、艺术与建筑，首府后来迁往勒克瑙。

english: Kishi-Karoy, 'Little Karoy', occupies a closed depression in the southern Ishim Plain, at the edge of the West Siberian lowlands. Its larger counterpart, Ulken-Karoy, lies to the east. No great river feeds this bitter salt lake: snow supplies most of its water, and the flat, partly clayey bed is encircled by salt marshes. Summer evaporation shrinks the lake and raises its salinity, while severe drought can leave the basin entirely dry. Sagebrush and fescue cover the surrounding arid Kazakh steppe, placing this changeable sheet of water within a much broader landscape of saline hollows and open grassland.
simp_chinese: 克什卡罗伊意为“小卡罗伊”，占据西西伯利亚低地边缘、伊希姆平原南部的一处封闭洼地。更大的乌尔肯卡罗伊湖位于其东面。这座苦咸湖没有大河补给，主要依靠融雪蓄水；平坦且部分呈黏土质的湖床周围环绕着盐沼。夏季蒸发使湖面收缩、盐度上升，严重干旱时甚至可能完全干涸。周围干燥的哈萨克草原生长着蒿草和羊茅，这片变幻不定的水面，属于盐碱洼地与开阔草地交织的广阔景观。

english: Kishim occupies the Keshem Valley on the western edge of Badakhshan. The district is predominantly rural, with its administrative centre at Mashhad. Its valley setting belongs to the cold continental country of northeastern Afghanistan, where warm summers give way to winters with average temperatures below freezing. The name therefore describes a settled valley district as well as a point on the approaches to Badakhshan's interior.
simp_chinese: 基希姆位于巴达赫尚西缘的凯谢姆河谷。这里以乡村地区为主，行政中心设在马什哈德。河谷属于阿富汗东北部寒冷的大陆性气候地带，温暖的夏季过后，是平均气温降至冰点以下的冬季。基希姆这个名称因而既指一片有人定居的河谷地区，也标示着通往巴达赫尚腹地的入口地带。

english: Kishima is one of the districts of Hizen in northwestern Kyushu. The wider province occupied the Saga and Nagasaki mainland and belonged to Saikaidō; its ports of Hirado and Nagasaki later became major centres of contact with Portuguese and Spanish traders.
simp_chinese: 杵岛是九州西北部肥前国的郡之一。更广阔的肥前涵盖佐贺与长崎本土，属于西海道；平户和长崎后来成为接触葡萄牙、西班牙商人的重要港口。

english: Kishtwar stands in the hill country between Jammu and Kashmir. Its older name, Kashtvatha, appears in Kalhana's Rajatarangini, composed in 1148, giving the town a place in the written historical tradition of Kashmir. A broad open space called the Chowgan occupies the heart of the settlement. The local linguistic landscape also links it to Kashmir: Kashmiri is widely spoken, alongside the Kishtwari variety associated with the town's Hindu inhabitants. These names and forms of speech preserve a regional identity beyond the modern boundaries of the district.
simp_chinese: 基什德瓦尔坐落在查谟与克什米尔之间的山地。迦尔诃那于1148年写成的《王河》中，已出现当地古名Kashtvatha，使这座城镇进入克什米尔的书面历史传统。城镇中心有一片称为Chowgan的宽阔空地。当地语言面貌也与克什米尔相连：居民广泛使用克什米尔语，印度教居民则使用与城镇相关的基什德瓦里变体。这些地名与语言形式，保存着超出现代地区边界的区域身份。

english: Kishwaukee belongs to the Illinois country of the Great Lakes interior. The wider region reaches Lake Michigan in the northeast and the Mississippi along much of its western side.
simp_chinese: 基什沃基属于五大湖内陆的伊利诺伊地区。更广阔的区域东北抵密歇根湖，西部大部分沿密西西比河延伸。

english: Kisi, also called Kishi, stands in northern Oyo near the old capital of Katunga. Its oral traditions recall Baruba and Yoruba founders, and the town later received people displaced from Old Oyo during the Fulani wars.
simp_chinese: 基西又称基希，位于奥约北部，靠近旧都卡通加。当地口述传统记载了巴里巴人与约鲁巴人的建城故事；后来在富拉尼战争中，城镇又接纳了离开旧奥约的居民。

english: Kisiju belongs to the Swahili coast of East Africa. Across the wider coast, river estuaries provided natural harbours and seasonal monsoon winds sustained Indian Ocean commerce.
simp_chinese: 基西朱属于东非斯瓦希里海岸。在更广海岸，河口提供天然港湾，季节性季风支撑印度洋商业。

english: Kisikkamys lies in the wider Ryn country north of the Caspian Sea and west of the Ural River. The Ryn Desert has loosely defined boundaries, little rainfall and strong winds that carry its dust far beyond the region.
simp_chinese: 基西卡梅斯位于里海以北、乌拉尔河以西的雷恩地区。就更广的雷恩沙漠而言，其边界并不明确，降雨稀少，强风能将沙尘带往遥远地区。

english: Kisimani Mafia preserves some of Mafia Island’s oldest ruins near Kilindoni. Mosque strata date to around the tenth and eleventh centuries, while coastal erosion has carried walls into the channel and sometimes exposes ancient coins on the shore.
simp_chinese: 基西马尼马菲亚在基林多尼附近保存着马菲亚岛最古老的一批遗迹。清真寺地层约可追溯至十至十一世纪，海岸侵蚀将墙体带入海峡，也偶尔使古钱币出现在岸边。

english: Kisiskaciwani Sipiy belongs to the Saskatchewan country of western Canada. The wider region combines southern prairie with northern forest, and contains many rivers and lakes.
simp_chinese: 基西卡奇瓦尼西比属于加拿大西部的萨斯喀彻温地区。更广阔的区域兼有南部草原和北部森林，并分布着众多河流与湖泊。

english: Kiskiack, a name meaning Broad Place or Wide Land, belonged to both an Algonquian-speaking people and their village near the southern bank of Virginia's York River. The community formed one of the original four members of the Powhatan Confederacy. Related families lived in permanent longhouses, or yihakans, which combined shared spaces with private household areas. English settlement at Jamestown in 1607 brought growing pressure over land and food, followed by war and retaliation. The Kiskiack left their village before 1627, and English colonists occupied the site in 1629 while retaining its name. In 1634 a colonial palisade reached across the peninsula to Kiskiack, making the former village a landmark in an expanding frontier that had displaced its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 基斯基亚克意为宽广之地，既是一个讲阿尔冈昆语的族群之名，也是他们在弗吉尼亚约克河南岸附近村庄的名称。该社群是波瓦坦联盟最初的四个成员之一。亲属家庭居住在称为伊哈坎的固定长屋中，屋内兼有共同空间与各户私用区域。1607年英国人在詹姆斯敦定居后，围绕土地与粮食的压力日益加剧，继而爆发战争与报复。基斯基亚克人在1627年以前离开村庄，英国殖民者于1629年占据原址，并沿用了地名。1634年，横跨半岛的殖民栅墙修至基斯基亚克；这座旧村庄由此成为扩张边疆的一个标志，而原来的居民已经被迫迁离。

english: Kiskissink is lake country northeast of La Tuque in Quebec. Its long, narrow lake stretches north to south for about eleven kilometres, close to the divide with the Lac Saint-Jean watershed; nearby heights rise above its surface, roughly 416 metres above sea level.
simp_chinese: 基斯基辛克是魁北克拉蒂克东北方的湖区。当地狭长湖泊南北延伸约十一公里，靠近与圣让湖水系之间的分水岭；周围山地高出海拔约四百一十六米的湖面。

english:
Kismayo stands on the southern Somali coast beside the fertile country of the Jubba valley. The settlement began as a small fishing community, while the surrounding region came under the medieval Ajuran Sultanate, whose plantations drew upon the Jubba River. After Ajuran power collapsed, the Geledi Sultanate and the House of Gobroon extended their influence over the area.

Seasonal monsoon winds and irregular rainfall shape this hot coast. The gu rains bring fresh water and renewed vegetation between April and July, followed by the xagaa dry season. In the later nineteenth century Kismayo became entangled in the partition of the Swahili coast: British administration followed arrangements with Zanzibar, and the town was eventually transferred to Italian control in the twentieth century.
simp_chinese:
基斯马尤位于索马里南部海岸，邻近朱巴河谷肥沃的土地。聚落最初是一个小渔村，周边地区在中世纪归阿朱兰苏丹国统治，其种植园利用朱巴河的水源。阿朱兰势力瓦解后，格莱迪苏丹国及其戈布龙王族将影响扩展到这一地区。

季风与不稳定的降雨塑造着这片炎热海岸。四月至七月的古雨季带来淡水和复苏的草木，随后进入哈加旱季。19世纪后期，基斯马尤卷入斯瓦希里海岸的瓜分：英国依据与桑给巴尔达成的安排实行管理，20世纪时城镇又被转交意大利控制。

english: Kiso belongs to the wider Tōsandō region of old Japan. The Eastern Mountain Circuit embraced ancient provinces of central and northern Honshu, with roads linking their provincial capitals.
simp_chinese: 木曾属于古代日本更广阔的东山道地区。东山道涵盖本州中北部多个令制国，各国国府通过道路相连。

english: The Kiso Mountains rise through central Honshu as the granite spine of the Central Alps. Together with the Hida and Akaishi ranges they form the larger Japanese Alps, but their own narrow mountain belt extends roughly sixty-five kilometres. Mount Kisokoma, the highest summit, reaches about 2,956 metres, while Hōken and Utsugi add other formidable peaks. Streams born among these heights feed the Kiso and Tenryū river systems on their way toward the Pacific. Above the tree line, alpine plants replace the forests below; a local form of edelweiss, Leontopodium shinanense, is endemic around Kisokoma. Bare rock, high ridges, and distinct upland vegetation give this interior of Shinano a character sharply different from its settled low valleys.
simp_chinese: 木曾山脉耸立于本州中部，以花岗岩构成中央阿尔卑斯山的骨架。它与飞驒、赤石两大山系共同组成日本阿尔卑斯山，其中木曾自身是一条长约65公里的狭长山带。最高峰木曾驹岳海拔约2956米，宝剑岳、空木岳等山峰也同样雄峻。发源于高山间的溪流汇入木曾川与天龙川水系，最终奔向太平洋。林线以上，山地森林让位于高山植物；火绒草属的信浓薄雪草是木曾驹岳周边的特有植物。裸露岩石、高耸山脊与独特植被，使信浓这片腹地呈现出与有人定居的低谷截然不同的面貌。

english: Kisomba lies in the Bangweulu country on the Zambian plateau. The wider lake and wetland system belongs to the upper Congo basin, combining open water, permanent swamps, shifting channels and seasonally flooded grasslands; miombo woodland covers much of the drier margin.
simp_chinese: 基松巴位于赞比亚高原的班韦乌卢地区。整个湖泊湿地系统属于刚果河上游流域，由开阔水面、常年沼泽、变动水道和季节性淹水草地组成，较干燥的边缘多为米翁博林地。

english: Kissi belongs to the wider Gao region on the Niger. Gao stood at the junction of the river and Tilemsi valley and became an important centre of trans-Saharan trade.
simp_chinese: 基西属于尼日尔河沿岸更广阔的加奥地区。加奥位于河流与提莱姆西河谷交接处，曾是跨撒哈拉贸易的重要中心。

english: Kissidougou stands beside the Niandan in southern Guinea, where savanna and islands of humid forest form a varied landscape. Its name is understood in Malinke as a place of refuge. A foundation tradition links the settlement to Mansa Dankaran Toumani, driven from Dakajalan by Soumaoro Kanté in the early thirteenth century. Kouranko communities, together with Kissi, Malinke, Fula and others, belong to the region's social landscape. The forest patches around villages have a history of their own: oral accounts describe ancestors founding settlements on savanna and encouraging trees around them. Planting, cultivation at village margins and ordinary household activities could help these wooded islands develop, making the landscape a record of human care as well as natural growth.
simp_chinese: 基西杜古位于几内亚南部尼安丹河畔，稀树草原与湿润森林斑块交织，形成多样的景观。它的名称在马林克语中被解释为避难之所。一种建城传统将聚落与曼萨·丹卡兰·图马尼相联系，据说十三世纪初，他被苏马奥罗·坎特逐出达卡贾兰后来到这里。库兰科社群与基西人、马林克人、富拉人等共同构成当地社会。村庄周围的林地也有自身的历史：口述记忆描述祖先在草原上建立聚落，并逐渐促使树木在周边生长。种树、村边耕作和日常家居活动，都可能帮助这些林岛形成，使景观同时留下人为照料与自然生长的痕迹。

english: Kistapinan belongs to the Saskatchewan river country, whose regional name comes from a Cree expression meaning swift-flowing river. Across the wider province, Cree, Assiniboine, Saulteaux and other Indigenous peoples inhabited the land before European traders followed the rivers inland.
simp_chinese: 基斯塔皮南属于萨斯喀彻温河地区，其区域名称源于意为湍急河流的克里语。更广阔的萨斯喀彻温地区早已有克里、阿西尼博因、索托等原住民族群居住，欧洲商人后来才沿河深入内陆。

english: Kita belongs to the southern Malian landscape of Sudanian savanna. In the wider region, the Niger and Senegal rivers supported settlement, while successive Ghana, Mali and Songhai empires controlled trans-Saharan trade.
simp_chinese: 基塔属于马里南部的苏丹草原地带。在更广大的地区，尼日尔河与塞内加尔河孕育了聚落，加纳、马里和桑海帝国则先后控制着跨撒哈拉贸易。

english: North Iwo Jima is the northernmost of the Volcano Islands, a steep, eroded volcanic summit rising about 792 metres above the Pacific. Its small land area conceals a far larger submerged volcanic mass. Altars, graves, tools and pottery discovered here have been attributed to Micronesian visitors or inhabitants between the eighth and sixteenth centuries. Spanish ships passed the island group during early attempts to find an eastward route from the Philippines to New Spain; Bernardo de la Torre probably sighted it in 1543. Permanent Japanese villages belong to a much later chapter, beginning with fishermen from the Bonin Islands in 1898. Their two settlements occupied the eastern and western sides of this isolated peak.
simp_chinese: 北硫黄岛是火山列岛最北端的岛屿，由一座陡峭、受侵蚀的火山峰构成，耸立于太平洋上约792米。狭小的陆地之下，是规模大得多的水下火山体。岛上发现的祭坛、墓葬、工具与陶器，被认为属于八至十六世纪之间到访或居住于此的密克罗尼西亚人。西班牙船只曾在早期寻找从菲律宾向东驶往新西班牙的航路时经过这片群岛；贝尔纳多·德拉托雷很可能于1543年望见了它。日本人的永久村落则属于晚近得多的篇章，始于1898年来自小笠原群岛的渔民。他们的两个聚落分别位于这座孤峰的东侧与西侧。

english: North Iwo Jima’s coast surrounds the northernmost of Japan’s Volcano Islands. The island is the eroded summit of an active stratovolcano, roughly eighty kilometres north of Iwo Jima.
simp_chinese: 北硫黄岛海岸环绕日本火山列岛最北部的岛屿。它是一座活跃层状火山受到侵蚀后的山顶，位于硫黄岛以北约八十公里。

english: Kita lies in Iyo, one of the provinces included in the ancient Nankaidō circuit. At this wider administrative scale, the circuit embraced Shikoku, Awaji and Kii, linked by roads between provincial capitals and sea crossings.
simp_chinese: 喜多位于伊予，伊予是古代南海道所辖诸国之一。从这一更广的行政层面看，南海道包括四国、淡路与纪伊，以连接国府的道路和渡海路线串联。

english: Kitaaizu belongs to the northern Japanese country of Tohoku. The wider region embraces the old Dewa and Mutsu lands, whose history was shaped by Emishi communities and the expansion of Yamato settlement.
simp_chinese: 北会津属于日本北部的东北地区。更广阔的区域包括古代出羽与陆奥，其历史受到虾夷社区及大和人定居扩张的塑造。

english: Kitagnaq belongs to the wider Alaskan world between the North Pacific and the Arctic. Alaska faces Chukotka across the Bering Strait, a narrow maritime boundary between North America and Asia.
simp_chinese: 基塔格纳克属于北太平洋与北冰洋之间更广阔的阿拉斯加地域。阿拉斯加隔白令海峡与楚科奇相望，这条狭窄海峡分隔北美洲与亚洲。

english: Hei belongs to the northern Honshu country later organised as Rikuchū Province. Rikuchū was separated from Mutsu in 1869 and covered much of modern Iwate together with parts of northeastern Akita.
simp_chinese: 闭伊位于本州北部、后来设置陆中国的地域。陆中国于1869年从陆奥国分出，覆盖现代岩手大部及秋田东北部的一些地区。

english: Kitakamikawa belongs to the Hokkaido lands historically called Ezo. The wider name once covered lands northeast of Honshu and could also include Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands, associated with the ancestors of today’s Ainu.
simp_chinese: 北上川属于历史上称为虾夷地的北海道土地。广义地名曾涵盖本州东北以外地区，有时包括萨哈林与千岛群岛，并与今日阿伊努人的祖先相联系。

english: Kitamogami belongs to Tōhoku, the northeastern country of Japan’s main island of Honshu. The wider region is also called Ōu and has long been associated with remote landscapes and a harsh climate.
simp_chinese: 北最上属于日本本州东北部的东北地区。更广阔的地域也称奥羽，长期以来以偏远景观与严酷气候为人所知。

english: Kitamorokata belongs to Hyūga within the old Saikaidō circuit. Established as part of the Asuka-period Gokishichidō system, the circuit embraced Kyushu’s nine provinces together with Iki and Tsushima. Its name also referred to the main road linking this southwestern world.
simp_chinese: 北诸县属于日向，位于古代西海道范围内。西海道是飞鸟时代五畿七道体系的一部分，涵盖九州九国及壹岐、对马。这个名称也用于连接西南地域的主要道路。

english: Kitamuro belongs to the eastern Kii Peninsula landscape now included in Mie Prefecture. Before the Meiji Restoration, the modern prefecture’s lands were divided among Ise, Shima, Iga and part of Kii, preserving several distinct provincial traditions.
simp_chinese: 北牟娄属于今日三重县境内的纪伊半岛东部。明治维新以前，现代县域分属伊势、志摩、伊贺以及纪伊的一部分，保留着多种不同的旧国传统。

english: Kitanakagawa belongs to the wider Ezo country of Japan’s northern islands. Historical usage of Ezo extended over Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Kurils, lands associated with the ancestors of today’s Ainu communities.
simp_chinese: 北中川属于日本北方岛屿更广阔的虾夷地区。历史上虾夷之名曾涵盖北海道、萨哈林与千岛群岛，这些土地与今日阿伊努社群的祖先相关。

english: The Kitanemuk homeland straddles the Tehachapi Mountains and Antelope Valley at the western edge of the Mojave Desert. Its people lived in semi-permanent villages and spoke a Uto-Aztecan language closely related to those of neighbouring southern Californian peoples. Autumn acorns and stored piñon nuts supported the yearly food supply. Tule-reed seedbeaters gathered chia and other seeds, which were ground into flour, mixed with water and baked into small cakes in earth ovens. During the later eighteenth century, Spanish missions drew some Kitanemuk away to San Fernando and San Gabriel, bringing profound changes to the communities of this mountain and desert borderland.
simp_chinese: 基塔内穆克人的家园跨越莫哈韦沙漠西缘的特哈查皮山脉与羚羊谷。当地人居住在半固定村落中，使用一种与南加利福尼亚邻近族群语言关系密切的犹他阿兹特克语系语言。秋季采集的橡实和储藏的松子维持着全年的食物供应。人们用芦苇编成的采籽拍收集奇亚等植物种子，将其磨粉、和水，再在土炉中烤成小饼。十八世纪后期，西班牙传教站将部分基塔内穆克人迁往圣费尔南多和圣加布里埃尔，为这片山地与沙漠交界地带的社区带来深刻变化。

english: The Kitasoo are a southern Tsimshian people of the Pacific Northwest coast. Their community shares Klemtu with the Xai'xais, and their traditional language belongs to the southern dialect group of Tsimshian.
simp_chinese: 基塔苏是太平洋西北海岸的南部钦西安族群。他们与海海斯人共同居住在克莱姆图，传统语言属于钦西安语的南部方言群。

english: Kitauonuma belongs to the old Hokurikudō circuit of Japan. The wider circuit grew from Wakasa and Koshi, with the latter divided into Echizen, Etchū and Echigo before further changes produced seven provinces.
simp_chinese: 北鱼沼属于日本古代的北陆道。更广阔的北陆道最初由若狭和越组成，越后来分为越前、越中和越后，再经调整形成七国。

english: Japan's northeastern coast faces the Pacific beyond its mountain islands. The wider archipelago separates the open ocean from the Sea of Japan, with thousands of smaller islands around four principal landmasses.
simp_chinese: 日本东北岸在山地列岛之外面向太平洋。广阔群岛将外海与日本海分隔，四座主要岛屿周围还有数千小岛。

english: Esopus communities occupied the Catskill and Hudson Valley country. Speaking Munsee, they moved seasonally between small settlements near water, cultivating maize, beans and squash while hunting and gathering the varied resources of the surrounding forests.
simp_chinese: 埃索普斯社群生活于卡茨基尔山和哈得孙河谷。他们使用芒西语，随季节在近水小聚落间移动，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，并在周围森林狩猎采集。

english: Kitchesatsiou lies within the broad Quebec country. The later province preserves a Francophone cultural world rooted in New France, whose colony of Canada passed to Britain following the Seven Years’ War.
simp_chinese: 基切萨齐乌位于广阔的魁北克地区。后来的魁北克保留着根植于新法兰西的法语文化，其加拿大殖民地在七年战争后转归英国。

english: Kitchigumi belongs to the Lake Superior country of the Great Lakes. The lake’s Ojibwe name means great sea, and its waters drain through the Saint Marys River into Lake Huron.
simp_chinese: 基奇古米属于五大湖中的苏必利尔湖地区。湖泊的奥吉布瓦语名称意为大海，湖水经圣玛丽河流入休伦湖。

english: Kitcisakik is an Anicinape settlement in the lake country of western Quebec. It was formerly known as Grand-Lac-Victoria, retaining a close association between the community's identity and the surrounding waters of Témiscamingue.
simp_chinese: 基奇萨基克是魁北克西部湖区的一处阿尼希纳贝聚落，旧称大维多利亚湖。名称和社区身份，都与泰米斯卡明格周围的湖泊环境密切相连。

english: Kitete belongs to the broader Lomami country of the Congo basin. The Lomami rises near the Congo-Zambezi divide and flows north, roughly parallel to the upper Congo. It eventually joins the great river at Isangi.
simp_chinese: 基泰特属于刚果盆地广义洛马米地区。洛马米河发源于刚果—赞比西分水岭附近，向北大致平行于刚果河上游流淌，最终于伊桑吉汇入大河。

english: Near the meeting of the Désert and Gatineau rivers, Kitigan Zibi takes its Algonquin name from the idea of a garden or cultivated clearing beside a river. In the first half of the nineteenth century, Algonquins from the mission at Lake of Two Mountains came to the Désert under Chief Pakinawatik. The Hudson's Bay Company followed in 1832, placing a trading post at the river's mouth. The reserve itself belongs to a later administrative history: it was legally established in 1851 and demarcated in 1853 after negotiations in which Pakinawatik and other leaders travelled by canoe to Upper Canada. Rivers, forest and numerous lakes remain the defining features of this Algonquin homeland.
simp_chinese: 在德塞尔河与加蒂诺河交汇处附近，基蒂甘齐比的阿尔冈昆语名称，表达着河畔园圃或开垦空地的意思。十九世纪上半叶，来自双山湖传教站的阿尔冈昆人在帕基纳瓦蒂克首领率领下，来到德塞尔河一带。哈德逊湾公司随后于1832年在河口设立贸易站。保留地本身则属于更晚的行政沿革：帕基纳瓦蒂克与其他领袖曾乘独木舟前往上加拿大谈判，保留地最终于1851年依法设立，1853年划定边界。河流、森林与众多湖泊，始终构成这片阿尔冈昆家园的鲜明面貌。

english: Kitō belongs to Tōtōmi, the old Japanese province in western Shizuoka. The wider province took its name from Lake Hamana and had its early capital at Mitsuke, later a post town on the Tōkaidō.
simp_chinese: 城东属于日本旧远江国，位于今静冈西部。广义远江国得名于滨名湖，早期国府设在见付，后来这里成为东海道宿场。

english: Kits’ixta belongs to the Niobrara river country of the Great Plains. The river crosses Wyoming and Nebraska to reach the Missouri, draining dry plains and the northern Sandhills. Its lower valley is the traditional homeland of the Ponca.
simp_chinese: 基茨伊克斯塔属于大平原奈厄布拉勒河地域。河流穿过怀俄明和内布拉斯加汇入密苏里河，流域覆盖干燥平原及沙丘地区北缘。下游河谷是庞卡人的传统家园。

english: The Kichai, who called themselves K'itaish, belonged to the Caddoan-speaking peoples of the southern Plains and were closely related to the Pawnee. French explorers encountered them on the Red River in 1701, and by 1772 their main settlements lay east of the Trinity River near present-day Palestine in Texas. Their political relationships crossed simple boundaries: although early Europeans described them as enemies of the Caddo, they also allied and intermarried with some Caddoan groups. They fought the Hainai beside the Trinity in 1712. In 1837, at the Battle of Stone Houses, Kichai warriors defeated Texas Rangers despite losing their leader in the opening attack.
simp_chinese: 基察伊人自称 K'itaish，属于南部大平原操卡多语系语言的族群，与波尼人关系密切。1701年，法国探险者在红河遇见他们；到1772年，其主要聚落已位于得克萨斯今日巴勒斯坦市附近、三一河以东。他们的政治关系并不受简单界线限制：早期欧洲人虽称其为卡多人的敌人，他们也与部分卡多族群结盟并通婚。1712年，他们在三一河畔与海奈人交战。1837年的石屋之战中，基察伊战士尽管在最初交锋中失去首领，仍击败了得克萨斯游骑兵。

english: Vancouver Island shelters the inner coastal waters of British Columbia. Across them the mainland opens around the Fraser valley and Burrard Inlet.
simp_chinese: 温哥华岛遮蔽着不列颠哥伦比亚内侧沿海水域。对岸大陆在弗雷泽河谷与布勒内湾周边展开。

english: Kittanning stands on the east bank of the Allegheny at the end of an old Indigenous path. Its name comes from Lenape Kithanink, meaning on the main river, and the eighteenth-century village was destroyed in an attack in 1756.
simp_chinese: 基塔宁位于阿勒格尼河东岸、一条古老原住民道路尽头。名称源于勒纳佩语Kithanink，意为大河之上，十八世纪村落于1756年的袭击中被毁。

english: The Kittitas, also called Upper Yakama, occupied valleys around the upper Yakima. Their name recalls a gravel-bank place, and their position gave them an intermediary role between Plateau peoples and Coast Salish communities beyond the Cascades.
simp_chinese: 基蒂卡斯人又称上雅卡马人，生活于雅基马河上游诸河谷。族名联系着一处砾石河岸，其地理位置使他们成为高原族群与喀斯喀特山以西海岸萨利希社群之间的中介。

english: Kittilä lies north of the Arctic Circle in the inland country of Finnish Lapland. Its landscape includes the rounded fells of Levi and Kätkätunturi, while the passing seasons bring an extraordinary contrast in daylight: weeks of midnight sun in early summer and a brief polar night in December. The inland position produces pronounced seasonal changes, with cold winters and moderate summers. The municipality was established in 1854, well after the medieval period, and later adopted the wolverine as its heraldic animal, a reminder of Lapland's wildlife. The surrounding fell country long predates the modern settlement's development into a holiday resort.
simp_chinese: 基蒂莱位于北极圈以北、芬兰拉普兰的内陆地区。这里的景观包括列维和凯特凯圆缓的山丘；季节流转也带来极为悬殊的日照，初夏连续数周太阳不落，十二月则有一段短暂的极夜。内陆位置使季节变化显著，冬季寒冷，夏季温和。基蒂莱于1854年建立市镇，远晚于中世纪，后来选用狼獾作为纹章动物，呼应拉普兰的野生动物。周围的山丘大地早已存在，聚落发展为度假胜地则是更晚近的故事。

english: Kitui lies in the interior of eastern Kenya, east of Machakos. Its name recalls an older craft tradition: in Kamba it means a place where iron goods are made. Kamba smiths who settled in the area before the colonial period gave it this name, preserving the memory of metalworking in the identity of the settlement. The surrounding population is predominantly Kamba, a Bantu-speaking people. Its later role as an administrative town belongs to modern Kenya, while its name reaches back to the artisans of the precolonial countryside.
simp_chinese: 基图伊位于肯尼亚东部内陆、马查科斯以东。它的名称保留着古老手工业的记忆：在坎巴语中，基图伊意为制造铁器的地方。殖民时期之前迁居此地的坎巴铁匠为这里取下此名，使金属加工的往事留存在聚落的身份之中。周围居民以讲班图语的坎巴人为主。后来作为行政城镇的地位属于现代肯尼亚的历史，而它的名字则可追溯到殖民前乡野中的工匠。

english: Kitungula belongs to the wider Moxico country of eastern Angola. Luena is the modern province’s capital. The region’s long frontier with Zambia made it an important base and battleground during the Angolan Civil War.
simp_chinese: 基通古拉属于安哥拉东部莫希科的广大地域。卢埃纳为现代省会。与赞比亚接壤的漫长边界，使该地区在安哥拉内战中成为重要基地与战场。

english: Kituwa stands beside the upper Tuckasegee River in the Great Smoky Mountains, a place the Cherokee regard as their original town and one of their seven mother towns. A platform mound built around the year 1000 became the foundation for a Cherokee townhouse, repeatedly renewed as a meeting place for communal decisions. Oral tradition associates this house with a sacred fire that was kept burning. Kituwa influenced communities along the Tuckasegee and Oconaluftee rivers, and its name became closely associated with Cherokee identity. British troops destroyed the town during the Anglo-Cherokee War of 1758–1761. Survivors moved west across the mountains to Mialoquo on the Little Tennessee River. Land cessions deprived the Cherokee of control of Kituwa by 1819, but the mound survived the later cultivation of the site.
simp_chinese: 基图瓦坐落于大烟山间的塔卡西吉河上游。切罗基人将它视为本族最初的城镇，也是七座母镇之一。约公元1000年修筑的台形土丘，后来成为切罗基议事屋的地基；这座供社群集会、共同决策的建筑经过多次重建。口述传统将议事屋与必须长明的圣火联系在一起。基图瓦影响着塔卡西吉河和奥科纳卢夫蒂河沿岸的聚落，其名也与切罗基人的族群认同紧密相连。1758至1761年的英切罗基战争期间，英军摧毁了城镇，幸存者越过山脉向西迁往小田纳西河畔的米亚洛夸。到1819年，一系列土地割让使切罗基人失去了对基图瓦的控制，但土丘仍在后来反复耕作的土地上保存下来。

english: Kitzbühel occupies the Leukental valley beside the Kitzbüheler Ache, among the mountains east of Innsbruck. Its name appears in twelfth-century records, and Duke Louis II of Bavaria granted it town rights in 1271. Walls enclosed a growing market settlement whose fortunes were also supported by silver and copper mining. Its allegiance shifted between Bavaria and Tyrol before Maximilian I acquired Kitzbühel, Kufstein and Rattenberg in the settlement of the Landshut succession war in 1504. Even within Tyrol, the three districts retained Bavarian law into the nineteenth century, preserving a distinctive legal position. St Catherine's Church, built in the 1360s, belongs to the town's medieval fabric, recalling the commercial and mining community long before its mountains became famous for winter sport.
simp_chinese: 基茨比厄尔位于因斯布鲁克以东群山之间的洛伊肯谷，临基茨比厄勒阿赫河而建。其名见于十二世纪文书，巴伐利亚公爵路德维希二世在1271年授予它城市权。城墙围护着日益发展的市场聚落，银矿与铜矿也支撑着当地生计。这里的归属曾在巴伐利亚和蒂罗尔之间转移，直到1504年，马克西米利安一世在解决兰茨胡特继承战争的安排中取得基茨比厄尔、库夫施泰因与拉滕贝格。三地虽然并入蒂罗尔，却直到十九世纪仍沿用巴伐利亚法律，保有特殊法律地位。十四世纪六十年代建成的圣凯瑟琳教堂，是其中世纪风貌的一部分，也让人想起群山以冬季运动闻名之前的商业与采矿社群。

english: Kitzingen stands on the Main amid the vineyards of Franconia. An eighth-century Benedictine monastery formed an early focus of settlement beside the river crossing, and the town's fortunes remained closely tied to the prince-bishops of Würzburg. Religious conflict reshaped it in the seventeenth century. In 1629 Bishop Philipp Adolf von Ehrenberg suppressed Protestantism and compelled more than a thousand inhabitants to depart; Swedish occupation followed during the Thirty Years' War. Johann Philipp von Schönborn's edict of toleration in 1650 encouraged the exiles to return, helping restore the town's prosperity. By the eighteenth century Kitzingen ranked among the important ports of the Main, carrying the products of its wine country into wider trade. Its thirteenth-century Falterturm and early seventeenth-century stone bridge remain distinctive witnesses to the older fortified river town.
simp_chinese: 基青根位于美因河畔，四周是法兰克尼亚的葡萄园。8世纪的一座本笃会修道院，在渡河处形成早期聚落中心；此后城镇的命运始终与维尔茨堡采邑主教紧密相连。17世纪，宗教冲突改变了这里。1629年，主教菲利普·阿道夫·冯·埃伦贝格压制新教，迫使一千多名居民离开；三十年战争期间，瑞典占领接踵而至。约翰·菲利普·冯·舍恩博恩于1650年颁布宽容敕令，鼓励流亡者返回，帮助城镇恢复繁荣。到18世纪，基青根已跻身美因河重要港口之列，将葡萄酒产区的出产送入更广阔的贸易网络。13世纪的法尔特塔和17世纪初的石桥，仍见证着古老设防河港的面貌。

english: The Kiusta coastal waters belong to the Pacific Northwest's Haida maritime region. Haida communities also lived in southeastern Alaska, alongside Tlingit communities, across a coastline linking islands and mainland shores.
simp_chinese: 基乌斯塔沿岸水域属于太平洋西北部海达人的海上地区。海达人也生活在阿拉斯加东南部，与特林吉特社群相邻，沿岸海路联系着岛屿和大陆海岸。

english: Kivualinagmut belongs to the wider Alaska region of northwestern North America. Alaska faces the Arctic Ocean in the north and the Pacific in the south, with the Bering Strait separating it from northeastern Asia.
simp_chinese: 基武阿利纳格穆特属于北美西北部的阿拉斯加地区。阿拉斯加北面北冰洋，南临太平洋，白令海峡将其与亚洲东北部分隔。

english: The Kiwai Jungle belongs to the river country around the Gulf of Papua. Across the wider region, streams descending from the southern highlands spread into large deltas along a concave coastline. Numerous languages and communities developed amid these waterways and coastal settlements.
simp_chinese: 基瓦伊丛林属于巴布亚湾周围的河流地域。在广阔区域，南部高地流下的河水沿内凹海岸展开为广大三角洲，众多语言与社区在水道和沿海聚落之间发展。

english: Kiwetin Sipi belongs to the Laurentian country of southern Quebec. At the wider historical scale, these lands were part of the province called Lower Canada from 1791 to 1841, named for its downstream position along the St. Lawrence.
simp_chinese: 基韦廷西比属于魁北克南部的劳伦琴地区。从更广阔的历史尺度看，这些土地在1791至1841年间是下加拿大省的一部分，该名称来自其在圣劳伦斯河下游的位置。

english: Odeba lies in the Mendota country of the wider Wisconsin region. Between about 1000 and 1500, Mississippian and Oneota communities built substantial settlements in this broader landscape, including the fortified village of Aztalan to the east. Oneota traditions are associated with the ancestors of the Iowa and Ho-Chunk; the region also sustained Menominee communities.
simp_chinese: 奥德巴位于门多塔地域，属于更广阔的威斯康星地区。约公元1000至1500年，密西西比文化与奥尼奥塔文化社群在这片地区建造了规模可观的聚落，包括东面的阿兹特兰设防村落。奥尼奥塔传统与艾奥瓦人及霍昌克人的祖先有关，这片地区也养育着梅诺米尼社群。

english: Kiya belongs to the wider Angara country of Siberia. The Angara drains Lake Baikal toward the Yenisey, forming a major waterway through the lands of present-day Irkutsk and Krasnoyarsk.
simp_chinese: 基亚属于西伯利亚更广阔的安加拉地区。安加拉河将贝加尔湖水引向叶尼塞河，构成穿过今伊尔库茨克与克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区的重要水道。

english: Kiyeng Yuriiaax belongs to the upper Lena country of eastern Siberia. The wider river rises in the Baikal Mountains and receives the Kirenga, Vitim and Olyokma on its northeastward journey. Permafrost underlies its immense drainage basin.
simp_chinese: 基延尤里亚赫属于东西伯利亚勒拿河上游地域。广大水系发源于贝加尔山，向东北流淌时接纳基廉加河、维季姆河和奥廖克马河。永久冻土分布于其庞大的流域之下。

english: The Black Sea town of Medea, later called Midye and Kıyıköy, occupies a hillside between the Pabuçdere and Kazandere streams. Dense oak woodland lies behind a coast whose inhabitants have depended on fishing and forestry. Byzantine walls enclose much of the old settlement, with surviving masonry showing repairs in the ninth and tenth centuries. Nearby, the rock-cut monastery of Saint Nicholas dates to the age of Justinian I. Its chapel, monks' cells and storerooms are cut into the rock, while a holy spring lies below. These remains join the settlement's sheltered river mouths and wooded hinterland in giving this corner of Thrace its distinctive character.
simp_chinese: 黑海沿岸的梅代亚后来称为米迪耶与克伊柯伊，坐落在帕布奇德雷河与卡赞德雷河之间的山坡上。海岸腹地覆盖茂密橡树林，当地居民依靠渔业和林业谋生。拜占庭城墙环绕大部分旧聚落，现存砌体留有九至十世纪修缮的痕迹。附近的圣尼古拉斯岩窟修道院可追溯到查士丁尼一世时代。礼拜堂、修士居室和储藏间均凿入岩石，下层还有一处圣泉。这些遗存与聚落附近受庇护的河口、森林覆盖的腹地，共同赋予色雷斯这一角独特的面貌。

english: Kiyiu belongs to the wider Saskatchewan region. This inland country spans prairie and forest, with freshwater lakes and rivers occupying a substantial part of its landscape.
simp_chinese: 基尤属于更广阔的萨斯喀彻温地区。这片内陆土地横跨草原与森林，淡水湖泊和河流在景观中占有重要地位。

english: Kiyl belongs to the Uil river country of western Kazakhstan. The wider river system begins in the Mugodzhar Hills and runs about 800 kilometres toward Lake Aktobe in the Caspian Depression. Numerous tributaries feed this long steppe watercourse.
simp_chinese: 基尔属于哈萨克斯坦西部乌伊尔河地域。广大水系发源于穆戈贾尔山，流程约八百公里，通向里海低地的阿克托别湖。众多支流汇入这条漫长的草原河流。

english: Kiyuska belongs to the Missouri river country of the Great Plains. For millennia, Indigenous peoples used the wider river system for food and transport, while great bison herds sustained communities across its basin.
simp_chinese: 基尤斯卡属于大平原的密苏里河地区。数千年来，原住民族利用更广河系获取食物和交通，庞大野牛群则养育着流域各地社群。

english: Kiyyangan was an old Ifugao village beside the Ibulao River across the Lagawe valley. Ifugao mythology identifies it with Wigan and Bugan, ancestral figures of the people. Its name survives in Kiangan, the former provincial capital near the Nagacadan rice terraces.
simp_chinese: 基扬岸是拉加韦河谷对面、伊布劳河畔的伊富高古村。伊富高神话将这里与族群祖先维甘和布甘相联系。其名延续为基安甘，这座旧省会邻近纳加卡丹梯田。

english: Kizel lies on its namesake river in the Kama basin, northeast of Perm. Its settlement history grew from the discovery of iron ore along the Kizel and Maly Kizel rivers in 1750, followed by the opening of a mine in 1762. Coal was found in 1786. The river dam entered service on 3 July 1788, a date traditionally taken as the beginning of the substantial settlement, and the Kizel factory began operating the following year. Water power and mineral deposits thus gave this part of the Urals its industrial character during the eighteenth century. The great expansion of the surrounding coal basin belonged to the later nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
simp_chinese: 基泽尔位于彼尔姆东北方、卡马河流域的同名河畔。当地的聚落历史伴随着1750年基泽尔河与小基泽尔河沿岸铁矿的发现而展开，1762年第一座矿山开工，1786年又发现了煤层。河上的水坝于1788年7月3日投入使用，这一天通常被视为较大聚落形成的起点；次年，基泽尔工厂开始运转。水力与矿藏由此在18世纪赋予这片乌拉尔地区以工业面貌。周边煤田的大规模扩张，则属于更晚的19与20世纪。

english:
Kizhi is a narrow island in Lake Onega, part of the exchange routes that linked Novgorod with the White Sea from at least the fourteenth century. Its villages belonged to the wider Spas-Kizhi district, where agriculture occupied the useful soil and local people also worked iron ore, timber and charcoal.

The island's wooden churches became its most distinctive monuments. After lightning destroyed earlier buildings, the Church of the Intercession was rebuilt, and the twenty-two-domed Transfiguration Church followed in 1714. Pine logs brought from the mainland were shaped with axes and fitted together with interlocking joints; aspen shingles covered the domes. Imperial demands for labour at mines and factories later provoked the Kizhi uprising of 1769–1771, tying this rural island to the struggles surrounding Karelia's industrial development.
simp_chinese:
基日是奥涅加湖中的狭长岛屿，至少从十四世纪起便处于连接诺夫哥罗德与白海的交换路线上。岛上村落属于范围更大的斯帕斯—基日地区，适宜利用的土地用于耕作，当地居民也参与铁矿、木材和木炭生产。

木教堂成为岛上最鲜明的建筑。早期教堂毁于雷击后，圣母代祷教堂得到重建，二十二座穹顶的主显圣容教堂又于1714年建成。建筑所用的松木从大陆运来，以斧加工，通过相互咬合的接榫拼接，穹顶覆以白杨木瓦。后来，帝国对矿山与工厂劳役的征发引发1769年至1771年的基日起义，将这座农业岛屿卷入卡累利阿工业发展带来的冲突。

english: The Kızılcahamam country lies among mountains and forests north of Ankara, near the transition from central Anatolia to the Black Sea region. Its market town is known for hot springs and mineral waters, drawing on the thermal resources beneath the uplands.
simp_chinese: 亚巴纳巴德一带位于安卡拉以北的山林之间，接近安纳托利亚中部与黑海地区的过渡地带。当地集镇以温泉和矿泉水闻名，利用了高地下方的地热资源。

english: Kizilsu takes its name from the Kezi River: in both Kyrgyz and Uyghur, the name means red water. The country lies at the western edge of Xinjiang, adjoining the lands now within Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. It is home to both Uyghur and Kyrgyz communities, with Artush serving as the centre of the modern prefecture. That administrative unit was created in 1954 and reorganised the following year; its twentieth-century boundaries should be distinguished from the older river name and the wider country it evokes.
simp_chinese: 克孜勒苏得名于克孜河，在柯尔克孜语和维吾尔语中都意为“红水”。这片土地位于新疆西缘，与今天属于吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦的地区相邻。维吾尔人与柯尔克孜人共同生活于此，现代自治州以阿图什为中心。这一行政单位创设于1954年，次年改组；其二十世纪形成的边界，与更古老的河流名称及其所指向的广阔地域应当分别看待。

english: Kjipuktuk is the Mi’kmaq name for the great natural harbour now called Halifax Harbour. A drowned glacial valley formed the deep inlet, which narrows before opening into Bedford Basin.
simp_chinese: 克吉普克图克是米克马克人对今日哈利法克斯港天然良港的称呼。被海水淹没的冰川谷地形成深水港湾，水道收窄后又通向贝德福德湾。

english: Kla Rome Ko belongs to the Pampas grassland country. Across the wider region, fertile low plains are interrupted by only a few hill systems and were later transformed by introduced livestock.
simp_chinese: 克拉罗梅科属于潘帕草原地区。在更广区域，肥沃低平原仅被少数丘陵打断，后来又因引入牲畜而改变。

english: Kladentsi belongs to southern Dobruja, the historical borderland around Dobrich and Silistra. Bulgarians and Turks lived here alongside Gagauz, Tatars and Romanians. In the twentieth century the wider region changed hands between Bulgaria and Romania, returning to Bulgaria under the Treaty of Craiova in 1940.
simp_chinese: 克拉登齐属于多布里奇与锡利斯特拉一带的南多布罗加历史地域。保加利亚人与土耳其人同加告兹人、鞑靼人和罗马尼亚人等群体共同生活于此。二十世纪，这片地区数度易手，最终依一九四〇年克拉约瓦条约归还保加利亚。

english: Klagenfurt grew at a crossing of commercial routes in Carinthia, near the eastern end of the Wörthersee. Flooding forced Duke Bernhard of Spanheim to move the settlement to a safer site in 1246; a town charter followed in 1252. After a devastating fire in 1514, Emperor Maximilian I handed the town to the Carinthian Estates in 1518. Their rebuilding gave it a new political importance and a Renaissance plan, with the Neuer Platz, noble town houses and formidable fortifications. A canal brought timber from the lake and supplied the moats. The famous lindwurm belongs to local legend, which tells of a dragon slain in the surrounding marshes; its monumental image became a fitting emblem for a town repeatedly remade from difficult ground.
simp_chinese: 克拉根福在卡林西亚商路交汇之处发展起来，靠近韦尔特湖东端。洪水迫使施潘海姆公爵伯恩哈德于1246年将聚落迁往更安全的地点，1252年又获授城镇特许状。1514年的大火造成严重破坏后，皇帝马克西米利安一世于1518年将城镇交给卡林西亚等级会议。重建赋予了它新的政治地位与文艺复兴式格局，新广场、贵族宅邸和坚固城防相继出现。一条运河从湖上运来木材，并为护城河供水。著名的林德虫则属于地方传说，讲述了周边沼泽中恶龙被杀的故事；它的巨大雕像成为这座屡次在艰难环境中重建的城镇颇为贴切的象征。

english: This country belongs to the Klahoose people of coastal British Columbia. Their main community stands at Squirrel Cove on eastern Cortes Island, and their heritage forms part of the Mainland Comox and Coast Salish world.
simp_chinese: 这片土地属于不列颠哥伦比亚沿海的克拉胡斯人。主要社群位于科特斯岛东侧的松鼠湾，其文化遗产属于大陆科莫克斯与海岸萨利希世界。

english: The Klamath Mountains spread across northwestern California and southwestern Oregon, gathering the Siskiyous, Trinity Alps, Marble Mountains, and other ranges into a rugged whole. Their rocks preserve an older geography: island arcs and fragments of continents were carried across the Pacific and joined to North America between roughly 260 and 130 million years ago. Serpentinite, marble, and intrusive rocks give the slopes remarkably varied soils. Heavy winter snow and dry summers support an exceptional diversity of conifers, including Brewer’s spruce and Port Orford cedar. Below the forests, rivers such as the Klamath, Trinity, and Rogue provide spawning waters for salmon and trout, connecting the high country with the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 克拉马斯山脉横跨加利福尼亚西北部与俄勒冈西南部，将锡斯基尤山、特里尼蒂阿尔卑斯山、马布尔山等山系连成一片崎岖高地。岩石保存着更古老的地理：岛弧与大陆碎片曾被带过太平洋，约在2.6亿至1.3亿年前陆续拼接到北美大陆上。蛇纹岩、大理岩与侵入岩赋予山坡极为多样的土壤。冬季大雪与干燥夏季滋养了异常丰富的针叶树种，其中包括布鲁尔云杉与劳森柏。森林下方，克拉马斯河、特里尼蒂河和罗格河等水系为鲑鱼与鳟鱼提供产卵场，将高山地区与太平洋相连。

english: Klang lies on the Malay Peninsula, facing the maritime routes of the Strait of Malacca. The wider peninsula is backed by the Titiwangsa Mountains, while the strait separates it from Sumatra to the west.
simp_chinese: 巴生位于马来半岛，面向马六甲海峡航路。整个半岛以蒂蒂旺沙山脉为骨干，西侧由海峡同苏门答腊分隔。

english:
Klatovy began as a settlement on the trade route from Bohemia to Bavaria, first recorded in 1253. Ottokar II made it a royal town between 1260 and 1263, and its walls were strengthened over the following centuries. Although the Hussite Wars and a fire in 1464 damaged the town, by the early sixteenth century it ranked among the leading towns of the Czech lands.

The Black Tower, built as a watchtower in 1547–1557, acquired its dark appearance through repeated fires. Jesuits arriving after the Thirty Years' War reshaped both education and architecture; beneath their Baroque church, burials from the 1670s to 1783 left a remarkable collection of mummified bodies. Klatovy also became known for carnations, with new varieties bred here from 1813.
simp_chinese:
克拉托维最初是波希米亚通往巴伐利亚商路上的一处聚落，1253年首次见于记载。奥托卡二世在1260至1263年间将它设为王家城市，城墙此后数百年间不断得到加强。尽管胡斯战争与1464年的大火造成破坏，十六世纪初，它仍已跻身捷克地区的重要城镇之列。

1547至1557年间建造的黑塔原是瞭望塔，反复发生的火灾使其外表变得黝黑。三十年战争后到来的耶稣会士，重新塑造了当地的教育与建筑；在他们的巴洛克教堂地下，1670年代至1783年间的墓葬留下了一批引人注目的木乃伊遗体。克拉托维还以康乃馨著称，自1813年起便在此培育新品种。

english: Kldekari belongs to Kartli in Georgia. The wider region is traversed by the Mtkvari River and played a major role in the medieval political and ethnic consolidation of the Georgian people.
simp_chinese: 克尔德卡里属于格鲁吉亚的卡特利。更广阔的地区有库拉河穿过，在中世纪格鲁吉亚人的政治与族群整合中发挥重要作用。

english: Kleisoura lies on Euboea, the long mountainous island beside mainland Greece. The narrow Euripus Strait separates the island from Boeotia, while mountain ridges run along its northwest-to-southeast axis.
simp_chinese: 克利苏拉位于希腊大陆旁狭长多山的优卑亚岛。狭窄的欧里普斯海峡将该岛与维奥蒂亚分开，山脊沿岛的西北至东南轴线延伸。

english: Kleisoura belongs to the Epirote country of what is now southern Albania. The wider area is often termed Northern Epirus, though that modern designation emerged from twentieth-century political disputes rather than a precisely bounded historical region.
simp_chinese: 克利苏拉属于今阿尔巴尼亚南部的伊庇鲁斯地区。整个地区常被称为北伊庇鲁斯，但这个现代名称产生于二十世纪政治争端，并非边界精确的历史区域。

english: Klendela belongs to the inland country of Angola. Across the wider landscape, a belt of hills and mountains separates the Atlantic coastal plain from the large interior plateau. This contrast between coast, upland margin and plateau shapes Angola’s geography.
simp_chinese: 克伦德拉属于安哥拉内陆地区。放眼更广阔景观，一道丘陵与山脉将大西洋沿岸平原和辽阔内陆高原隔开。海岸、山地边缘与高原之间的差异塑造了安哥拉地理。

english: Klepiki developed as a settlement in the sixteenth century, later becoming Spas-Klepiki. It stands on the Pra River, a tributary of the Oka, northeast of Ryazan.
simp_chinese: 克列皮基在十六世纪发展为聚落，后来成为斯帕斯—克列皮基。它位于梁赞东北部的普拉河畔，普拉河是奥卡河支流。

english: Kletsk stands on the Lan River, where the Dregoviches established a fortified tribal centre in the eleventh century. It entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the fourteenth century. In 1506, forces led by Michał Gliński defeated a Tatar army near the town, sparing it from pillage. Under the Radziwiłł family, Kletsk developed into a regional trading centre and became a notable seat of Calvinism. Its Jewish community appears in royal documents from 1522, when Sigismund I leased local inns and revenues to Isaac Jesofovitch of Brest. A provincial Baroque church built in 1683 adds a later architectural layer to this town of fortifications, markets and competing religious traditions.
simp_chinese: 克列茨克坐落在兰河畔，德列戈维奇人于十一世纪在此建立了设防的部族中心。十四世纪，城镇并入立陶宛大公国。1506年，米哈乌·格林斯基率军在城旁击败鞑靼军队，使克列茨克免遭劫掠。在拉齐维乌家族统治下，这里逐渐发展为地区贸易中心，并成为重要的加尔文宗据点。当地犹太社群在1522年的王室文书中已有记载，当时齐格蒙特一世将本地旅店及其他收入租给了布列斯特的艾萨克·耶索福维奇。1683年建造的地方巴洛克风格教堂，又为这座兼有堡垒、市场与多种宗教传统的城镇增添了一层历史。

english: Kletskaya is a Cossack stanitsa in the country of the lower Don. In modern administration it serves as the centre of Kletsky District in Volgograd Oblast.
simp_chinese: 克列茨卡亚是顿河下游地区的一座哥萨克村镇。在现代行政体系中，它是伏尔加格勒州克列茨基地区的中心。

english: Kleve grew beneath the Schwanenburg, the Swan Castle, on a steep promontory above the Lower Rhine country. The name probably refers to this cliff, while the castle's great tower became associated in legend with the Knight of the Swan. The medieval town joined together the castle, its dependent village, the settlement on Heideberg Hill and a fourteenth-century New Town; it received urban rights in 1242. Capital of a county and, from 1417, a duchy, Kleve became entangled in wider dynastic politics through the union with Jülich and Berg in 1521 and the succession crisis of 1609. In the seventeenth century Johann Moritz of Nassau-Siegen reshaped the ducal residence and commissioned gardens influential far beyond the town.
simp_chinese: 克莱沃兴起于下莱茵地区一处陡峭岬角上的施瓦嫩堡脚下；这座城堡的名字意为“天鹅堡”。城名可能源于这里的峭壁，而城堡的高塔则在传说中与天鹅骑士相连。中世纪的城市由城堡、附属村落、海德贝格山上的聚落和十四世纪的新城逐渐汇合而成，1242年获得城市权利。克莱沃先是伯国首府，1417年起又成为公国首府，随后因1521年与于利希、贝格合并，以及1609年的继承危机，卷入更广泛的王朝政治。十七世纪，拿骚-锡根的约翰·莫里茨改建公爵居所，并营造了影响远及城外的园林。

english: Klewi belongs to the Tu Nedhé country around Great Slave Lake. The wider lake is North America’s deepest, and its shores preserve a long sequence of Indigenous occupation after the retreat of the ice, from early Plano traditions to later Taltheilei communities.
simp_chinese: 克莱维属于大奴湖周边的图内德地区。范围更大的湖泊是北美最深的湖，沿岸保存着冰川退却后漫长的原住民居住序列，从早期普莱诺传统延续至后来的塔尔泰莱伊社群。

english: Klichaw lies in the Mogilev country of east-central Belarus. It first appears in records in 1592 as the village of Klichevo, then within Vitebsk Voivodeship. The First Partition of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth brought it into the Russian Empire in 1772, placing this small settlement within a radically altered political map. Its later growth was gradual: it became a district centre in 1924, received urban-type settlement status in 1938, and only gained formal town status in 2000. Modern roads connect it with Mogilev, Babruysk and Berazino, while food processing and timber industries contribute to the local economy.
simp_chinese: 克利乔夫位于白俄罗斯中东部的莫吉廖夫地区。1592年的文献首次记载了这处名为克利切沃的村落，当时它隶属维捷布斯克省。1772年波兰立陶宛联邦第一次被瓜分后，聚落归入俄罗斯帝国，周围的政治版图随之彻底改变。它此后的发展较为缓慢：1924年成为区级行政中心，1938年获得城市型居民点地位，直到2000年才正式取得城镇地位。现代公路将这里与莫吉廖夫、博布鲁伊斯克及别列津诺相连，食品加工和木材工业是当地经济的一部分。

english: Klikitat belongs to the Columbia Plateau world associated with the Yakama and neighbouring peoples. Across the wider region, communities hunted, gathered and traded salmon taken from the annual runs of the Columbia River.
simp_chinese: 克利基塔特属于与亚卡马及邻近诸族相联系的哥伦比亚高原世界。在更广阔的区域内，社区以狩猎、采集和交易哥伦比亚河每年洄游的鲑鱼维生。

english: Klin belongs to the wider Tver country of western Russia. Tver stood at the meeting of the Volga and Tvertsa rivers and was once the capital of a powerful medieval state.
simp_chinese: 克林属于俄罗斯西部广义的特维尔地区。特维尔位于伏尔加河与特维尔察河交汇处，曾是强盛中世纪国家的都城。

english: Klintsy began in 1707 as a sloboda founded by Old Believer peasants on the Turosna River. Its name preserves the surname of early settlers, Klinets, and the settlement initially belonged to the Starodub Regiment of the Cossack Hetmanate. Printing houses later specialised in Old Believer liturgical books, helping spread literacy among the inhabitants. In 1802 the posad became part of Surazh district in Chernigov province. Textile manufacture developed from the 1830s and eventually dominated the town's economy; its nineteenth-century mills earned Klintsy the name 'Manchester of Chernigov province'. Thus a refuge for religious dissenters grew into a centre of books and cloth.
simp_chinese: 克林齐始于1707年，由旧礼仪派农民在图罗斯纳河畔建立为斯洛博达聚落。其名称保留了早期定居者克利涅茨家族的姓氏，最初隶属哥萨克盖特曼国的斯塔罗杜布团。后来的印刷作坊以旧礼仪派礼仪书籍为主，推动了居民识字能力的提高。1802年，这处市镇划归切尔尼戈夫省苏拉日县。纺织制造业自十九世纪三十年代起发展，最终成为当地经济的支柱；十九世纪的工厂使克林齐赢得了“切尔尼戈夫省的曼彻斯特”之称。由宗教异议者建立的栖居地，就这样成长为书籍与布匹的生产中心。

english: Klipgat belongs to the Chainouqua country within the Cape’s wider Khoekhoe landscape. These pastoral communities traditionally moved with their livestock; seventeenth-century Cape Khoekhoe maintained large cattle herds. Later colonial change progressively disrupted that mobile way of life.
simp_chinese: 克利普加特属于开普更广阔科伊科伊地区内的柴努夸故土。这些牧业社群传统上随牲畜移动；十七世纪的开普科伊科伊人拥有大量牛群。后来的殖民变迁逐步打乱了这种流动生活方式。

english: Kljuc belongs to Bosnia in the western Balkans. The wider country lies between Croatia, Serbia and Montenegro and combines a continental climate with mountainous southeastern European terrain.
simp_chinese: 克柳奇属于巴尔干西部的波斯尼亚。广义地区介于克罗地亚、塞尔维亚与黑山之间，兼有大陆性气候与欧洲东南部山地地形。

english: Kłodzko, known also as Kladsko and Glatz, occupies a valley on the Eastern Neisse, where roads pass through the Sudetes between Bohemia and Poland. Cosmas of Prague's chronicle records the settlement under the year 981, and its early history was shaped by struggles between those neighbours. Restored to the Bohemian crown in 1334, the town flourished through commerce, German settlement and the work of its Augustinian community. A Gothic stone bridge crossed the Młynówka by 1390. In 1459 George of Poděbrady made the surrounding land a county within Bohemia; the town became its seat, before later wars increasingly made its great fortress the centre of local life.
simp_chinese: 克沃兹科又称克拉兹科或格拉茨，坐落在东尼斯河河谷，波希米亚与波兰之间的道路由此穿越苏台德山。布拉格的科斯马斯在编年史981年条下提及这处聚落，其早期历史深受两邻国争夺的影响。1334年重新归于波希米亚王冠后，商业、德意志移民与奥古斯丁会团体的活动推动城镇繁荣。至1390年，姆维努夫卡河上已建有哥特式石桥。1459年，波杰布拉德的伊日将周边土地升为波希米亚境内的伯国，城镇遂成为治所；此后的战争又使宏大的要塞逐渐成为当地生活的中心。

english: The Klondike belongs to the Yukon country, where First Nations maintained extensive trading networks long before European arrival. The gold rush beginning in 1897 brought a surge of newcomers; the resulting population growth helped lead to the creation of a separate Yukon Territory in 1898.
simp_chinese: 克朗代克属于育空地区，欧洲人到来以前，当地原住民族已拥有广泛的贸易网络。1897年开始的淘金热带来大量移民，随之而来的人口增长推动了1898年育空地区的单独设立。

english: Kluane belongs to the Southern Tutchone country of southwestern Yukon. The wider region contains Kluane Lake and the high mountains of Kluane National Park, including Mount Logan, Canada’s highest peak.
simp_chinese: 克卢恩属于育空西南部南塔琼人地区。更广阔的区域包括克卢恩湖与克卢恩国家公园高山，其中洛根山为加拿大最高峰。

english: Kluane Lake fills a long basin in southwestern Yukon, within the territories of the Kluane and White River First Nations and beside the traditional lands of Champagne and Aishihik. Its waters drain through the Kluane, Donjek and White rivers into the Yukon and ultimately the Bering Sea. Lake trout and whitefish inhabit the lake, while mountain caribou migrate through the surrounding country. For roughly three centuries before 2016, ice dams directed meltwater from the Kaskawulsh Glacier north into the lake through the Slims River. In May 2016 that supply abruptly shifted south toward the Alsek and the Gulf of Alaska, revealing how profoundly a glacier can reshape an entire watershed.
simp_chinese: 克卢恩湖占据育空西南部一处狭长湖盆，位于克卢恩与怀特里弗第一民族的领地内，毗邻尚帕涅与艾希希克的传统土地。湖水经克卢恩河、唐杰克河与怀特河汇入育空河，最终流向白令海。湖中栖息着湖鳟与白鲑，山地驯鹿则在周边地区迁徙。2016年以前约三个世纪间，冰坝将卡斯卡沃尔什冰川的融水导向北方，经斯利姆斯河注入湖泊。2016年5月，这股水流突然改道向南，流往阿尔塞克河与阿拉斯加湾，展现出冰川足以重塑整个流域的力量。

english: Kluczbork, long known as Kreuzburg, grew from the Silesian possessions of the Knights of the Cross with the Red Star. Its grant of Magdeburg rights in 1253 became the accepted foundation date, and authority soon passed from the order to officials of the local Piast dukes. The town shared Silesia’s shifting dynastic allegiances, passing under the Bohemian Crown in 1356 and later belonging to the Duchy of Brzeg. A mint operated here in the early fourteenth century; a salt-market privilege granted in 1426 and the later textile trade added to its commercial life. War and repeated fires checked that prosperity. The conflagration of 1737 spared little beyond the castle and a few houses, and reconstruction was still recent when Prussia annexed the town in 1741.
simp_chinese: 克卢奇堡长期以克罗伊茨堡之名为人所知，发端于红星十字骑士团在西里西亚的领地。1253年获授马格德堡法权的日子，成为公认的建城日期；不久后，城镇的管理权便从骑士团转交当地皮雅斯特公爵的官员。它随着西里西亚的王朝归属屡次易主，1356年转入波希米亚王冠之下，后来又属于布热格公国。十四世纪初，这里设有铸币厂；1426年获得的盐市特权，以及后来发展的纺织业，为商业生活增添了活力。战争与反复发生的火灾打断了这种繁荣。1737年的大火几乎只留下城堡与少数房屋，重建尚属近事，普鲁士便于1741年吞并了这座城镇。

english: Kluskapewiktuk belongs to the Indigenous coastal world later described by Europeans as Acadia. The wider region was inhabited by Wabanaki peoples and became a meeting ground with French settlers, whose first Acadian capital was established at Port-Royal in 1605.
simp_chinese: 克卢斯卡佩维克图克属于后来被欧洲人称为阿卡迪亚的原住民沿海世界。这一广大地区居住着瓦班纳基各族，后来与法国移民相遇；法国人于1605年在皇家港建立了阿卡迪亚的首个首府。

english: Tl’atii Na’ belongs to Alaska’s Athna country. The wider region lies at the northwestern edge of North America, where indigenous peoples occupied river valleys for thousands of years before European colonization.
simp_chinese: 克卢蒂纳属于阿拉斯加的阿瑟纳地区。更广阔的区域位于北美西北缘，欧洲殖民以前，原住民已在河谷生活数千年。

english: Klyuchi is a settlement in Kamchatka whose Russian name means springs. The modern locality was formerly classified as a town before becoming a rural settlement in 2004.
simp_chinese: 克柳奇是堪察加的一处聚落，俄语名称意为泉水。现代聚落原被列为城镇，2004年改为乡村聚落。

english: Kmito belongs to the wider Cuando or Mashi river country of south-central Africa. The river rises on Angola’s central plateau and flows through a broad, shifting corridor of swamp channels. Farther south it reaches the Linyanti wetlands, then continues as the Chobe toward the Zambezi.
simp_chinese: 克米托属于非洲中南部更广阔的宽多河又称马希河地区。河流发源于安哥拉中央高原，经过宽阔而多变的沼泽水道走廊。更南方进入林扬蒂湿地，再以乔贝河之名流向赞比西河。

english: Knin commands the Dalmatian hinterland near the source of the Krka, its fortress rising above a settlement first established on Spas hill. King Demetrius Zvonimir made it a regular royal residence around 1080, giving it a lasting association with the Croatian crown. It remained an administrative and ecclesiastical centre after the Hungarian Árpáds acquired the kingdom. In the early fourteenth century the Nelipić family made Knin its seat, until Louis I restored royal authority in 1345. The fortress contained a palace, houses and baths, while merchants from the coastal Dalmatian cities gathered in the town below; a fair on Saint Bartholomew's day is recorded from at least the 1360s. Ottoman conquest in 1522 and Venetian capture in 1688 brought further changes of population and rule. These successive powers valued the same position: a stronghold guarding an approach into Dalmatia.
simp_chinese: 克宁扼守克尔卡河源头附近的达尔马提亚腹地，堡垒高踞于最早形成在斯帕斯山上的聚落之上。约1080年，德米特里乌斯·兹沃尼米尔国王将这里作为经常驻跸的王室居所，使其与克罗地亚王权建立了长久联系。匈牙利阿尔帕德王朝取得王国之后，克宁仍是行政与教会中心。十四世纪初，内利皮奇家族以此为根据地，直到1345年路易一世恢复王权。堡内有宫殿、住宅和浴场，山下城镇则聚集着达尔马提亚沿海城市的商人；至少自1360年代起，圣巴尔多禄茂节便有集市记载。1522年的奥斯曼征服与1688年的威尼斯攻占又改变了当地人口与统治。这些相继而来的势力，都看重这座堡垒守护达尔马提亚入口的地势。

english: Knyazhich Gorodok belongs to the Beloozero country. Belozersk stands on the shore of Lake Beloye, and the medieval region was long inhabited by Finnic communities.
simp_chinese: 克尼亚日奇戈罗多克属于别洛奥泽罗地区。别洛泽尔斯克坐落在白湖岸边，中世纪的这一地区长期由芬兰族群居住。

english: Knyazhichi belongs to the wider Bryansk country on the Desna. The regional centre developed in the medieval Rus’ world and later passed between Lithuanian and Muscovite spheres of power.
simp_chinese: 克尼亚日奇属于杰斯纳河沿岸广义的布良斯克地区。地区中心在中世纪罗斯世界中发展，后来在立陶宛与莫斯科势力之间易手。

english: Knyazhoye belongs to the Pronsk country of western Ryazan. The wider Pronsky District covers roughly 1,070 square kilometres and has its administrative centre at Pronsk, linking the locality to this long-established regional name.
simp_chinese: 克尼亚若耶属于梁赞西部普龙斯克地区。广义普龙斯克区面积约1070平方千米，行政中心为普龙斯克，使此地与这一沿用已久的区域名称相联。

english: Ko Kwel belongs to the Coquille River homeland of southwestern Oregon. Communities fished in coastal tidewaters and estuaries using weirs and basket traps, and archaeological evidence records thousands of years of occupation.
simp_chinese: 科奎尔属于俄勒冈西南部的科奎尔河故土。社区利用鱼堰与篮阱在沿海潮汐水域和河口捕鱼，考古证据记录了数千年居住史。

english: Ko Samui rises in the Gulf of Thailand, with forested hills behind its coastal settlements. Oral tradition recalls fishermen from the Malay Peninsula settling here around the sixth century, although bronze ritual drums found in the southern hills point to a considerably older human presence. From the thirteenth century the island was linked to Siam's muang system through Nakhon Si Thammarat and participated in exchanges between China and India. It appears on a Chinese map of 1687 as Pulo Cornam. In the nineteenth century Hainanese merchants brought another wave of settlement, developing cotton and coconut plantations along the coast while many Thai inhabitants lived farther inland. The island's later fame as a resort belongs to the late twentieth century; for much of its earlier history fishing, cultivation and small-boat commerce sustained life around the wooded interior.
simp_chinese: 苏梅岛位于泰国湾，沿海聚落背后是森林覆盖的山地。口述传统称，来自马来半岛的渔民约在6世纪于此定居；南部山地出土的青铜仪式鼓则表明，人类在这里活动的年代要早得多。自13世纪起，苏梅岛经由那空是贪玛叻纳入暹罗的勐制网络，并参与中国与印度之间的交流。1687年的中国地图将它标作Pulo Cornam。19世纪，海南商人带来新一轮移民，在沿海经营棉花与椰子种植园，而许多泰族居民生活在更靠内陆的地方。海滨度假胜地的声名属于20世纪后期；在更长的早期历史中，捕鱼、耕作与小船贸易支撑着森林腹地周边的生活。

english: Koa-Aga-Itoka lies within the broader Great Basin world. Across this region, north–south mountain ranges rise between flat basins, a landscape formed by forces stretching the Earth’s crust.
simp_chinese: 科阿阿加伊托卡位于广义大盆地世界。在整个地区，南北走向的山脉耸立于平坦盆地之间，这种地貌由拉伸地壳的地质力量形成。

english: Koapolkan, or Cocibolca, is the great freshwater lake of Nicaragua. It drains east through the San Juan River to the Caribbean, making Granada an Atlantic-connected port despite the nearby Pacific. The lake’s tectonic basin is the largest freshwater lake in Central America.
simp_chinese: 科阿波尔坎又称科西沃尔卡，是尼加拉瓜的大淡水湖。湖水向东经圣胡安河流入加勒比，使格拉纳达虽靠近太平洋，仍是通向大西洋的港口。构造形成的湖盆是中美洲最大的淡水湖。

english: Koasati is the homeland name associated with the Coushatta, a Muskogean-speaking people once living in Tennessee, Georgia and Alabama. Closely allied with the Alabama people, they moved west under colonial pressure after 1763.
simp_chinese: 科阿萨蒂与库沙塔人的故土相联系，这一使用马斯科吉语族语言的民族曾生活在田纳西、佐治亚与阿拉巴马。他们长期与阿拉巴马人结盟，1763年后在殖民压力下向西迁移。

english: Koba belongs to Bangka, the island east of Sumatra. Across the wider island, low plains, swamps and small hills lie between the Bangka Strait and the seas toward Belitung, with tin mining long shaping the modern economy.
simp_chinese: 科巴属于苏门答腊以东的邦加岛。在更广阔的岛屿上，低平原、沼泽与小丘分布于邦加海峡和通往勿里洞的海域之间，锡矿开采长期塑造着现代经济。

english: Koban belongs to the North Caucasian country of Alania. The medieval Alan kingdom flourished between the ninth and thirteenth centuries and benefited from trade through the Darial Pass.
simp_chinese: 科班属于北高加索的阿兰地区。中世纪阿兰王国在九至十三世纪间兴盛，并从达里亚尔山口的贸易中获益。

english: Kobda is an aul in western Kazakhstan's Aktobe region. Its continental climate brings hot summers and very cold winters to the settlement and surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 科布达是哈萨克斯坦西部阿克托别地区的一处村镇。大陆性气候为聚落及周边地区带来炎热夏季与严寒冬季。

english: Copenhagen's natural harbour and the herring fisheries of the Sound drew fishermen and merchants well before it became a royal capital. Its name recalls this beginning as a merchants' haven. Bishop Absalon's fortress on Slotsholmen, traditionally dated to 1167, guarded a settlement exposed to attacks from Wendish pirates; a city charter followed in 1254. The growing port also attracted the hostility of the Hanseatic League, whose forces invaded in 1368. Eric of Pomerania later established his seat in Copenhagen Castle, and the university founded in 1479 added a centre of learning to the commercial town. Under Christian IV, the arsenal, stock exchange and canal district of Christianshavn expressed the ambitions of a maritime monarchy. The city withstood a Swedish siege in 1658–1659, but plague and great fires scarred the following century. Its later rebuilding created palaces and squares around a harbour that linked Baltic commerce to distant company trading ventures.
simp_chinese: 哥本哈根的天然港湾与厄勒海峡的鲱鱼渔场，早在它成为王都之前便吸引着渔民和商人。城名仍保留着“商人港湾”的起源。阿布萨隆主教在城堡岛修筑的堡垒，传统上定年为1167年，用以保卫遭受文德海盗袭扰的聚落；1254年，城镇获得城市特许状。港口日渐繁荣，也招来汉萨同盟的敌意，其军队于1368年攻入城中。此后，波美拉尼亚的埃里克将驻地迁入哥本哈根城堡，1479年创办的大学又为商业城镇增添了学术中心。克里斯蒂安四世时期兴建的军械库、交易所和拥有运河的克里斯蒂安港，彰显了海上君主国的抱负。城镇抵御了1658至1659年的瑞典围攻，但下一个世纪的瘟疫与大火留下重创。随后的重建在港口周围塑造出宫殿与广场，而这座港口则把波罗的海贸易同远方的公司商贸事业联结起来。

english: Kobirhat belongs to the broader Sonargaon country of Bengal. Sonargaon was a river port and an old regional capital, whose hinterland became an important center of muslin weaving and trade.
simp_chinese: 科比尔哈特属于孟加拉更广阔的索纳尔冈地区。索纳尔冈曾是河港与地区古都，其腹地成为细棉布织造和贸易的重要中心。

english: Kobra belongs to the Vyatka river system as one of its right-bank tributaries. The wider Vyatka drains northern Udmurtia toward the Kama, freezes from early November until late April, and supports a rich freshwater fishery.
simp_chinese: 科布拉是维亚特卡河的一条右岸支流。更广阔的维亚特卡水系将乌德穆尔特北部来水引向卡马河，通常从十一月初封冻至四月下旬，并有丰富的淡水鱼类。

english: Kobroor is one of the main Aru Islands in the Arafura Sea. Its neighbours include Wokam, Kola, Maikoor, Koba and Trangan.
simp_chinese: 科布罗尔是阿拉弗拉海阿鲁群岛的主要岛屿之一。邻岛包括沃卡姆、科拉、迈库尔、科巴和特兰甘。

english: Kobryn stands in Polesia on the Mukhavets, where the waterways of the western marches meet. First recorded in 1287, it became a Lithuanian princely seat held by a family descended from Grand Duke Algirdas. An Orthodox monastery was active here from the fourteenth century, while Princess Anna Kobryńska founded a Catholic church in 1500. Queen Bona Sforza later promoted the town's development. Magdeburg rights, granted in 1589, supported its life as a royal market town. Between 1774 and 1784 the Royal Canal linked the Mukhavets with the Pina, opening a water route between the Baltic and Black Sea basins. Russian annexation followed in 1795, and in 1812 Kobryn witnessed an early Russian victory during Napoleon's invasion.
simp_chinese: 科布林坐落在波列西耶的穆哈韦茨河畔，西部边地的水道在此交会。它于1287年首次见于记载，后来成为立陶宛的一处公国治所，由大公阿尔吉尔达斯的后裔家族掌有。十四世纪起，此地已有东正教修道院；1500年，安娜·科布林斯卡公主又创办一座天主教堂。此后，博娜·斯福尔扎王后推动城镇发展。1589年获授的马格德堡法权，支持了这座王室市镇的商业生活。1774至1784年间，皇家运河将穆哈韦茨河与皮纳河连通，打通了波罗的海和黑海流域之间的水路。1795年，此城被俄国吞并；1812年拿破仑入侵期间，俄军在这里取得了一场早期胜利。

english: Kobuk belongs to the wider Alaskan Arctic setting. Alaska’s northern shores face the Chukchi and Beaufort seas, while the Bering Strait separates its west from Asia.
simp_chinese: 科伯克属于更广阔的阿拉斯加北极地区背景。阿拉斯加北岸面向楚科奇海与波弗特海，西面则隔白令海峡与亚洲相望。
