simp_chinese: 科尼茨横跨内雷特瓦河，周围是黑塞哥维那北部林木繁茂的群山。在中世纪城镇形成很久以前，人们就已居住在这片河流地区；城名最早见于1382年6月16日的拉古萨记录。周围保存着数量尤其丰富的斯特茨石碑，这类雕刻墓碑是波斯尼亚与西巴尔干的特色。分布各处的墓地，让12至16世纪当地社群的生活留下可见痕迹。科尼茨原属波斯尼亚王国，奥斯曼征服后，清真寺与新的建筑传统随之出现。当地的老桥由阿里阿迦·哈塞契奇于1682至1683年修建，以六道略呈尖形的石拱跨越河面。这座桥成为城镇的标志之一；在河流与山地深刻影响通行的景观中，它将两岸连接起来。

english: Konjikala occupied the oasis country between the Köpetdag mountains and the Karakum Desert, on the site later covered by Ashgabat. It is first mentioned as a wine-producing village in the first or second century before the common era. An earthquake destroyed the settlement in the first century BC, but its position on the Silk Road encouraged rebuilding. Konjikala subsequently flourished until the Mongol destruction of the thirteenth century, after which a small village endured. The great modern city belongs to a later age: Ashgabat was founded in 1881 on the basis of an Ahal Teke village, long after the medieval trading settlement had declined.
simp_chinese: 孔吉卡拉位于科佩特山脉与卡拉库姆沙漠之间的绿洲地带，其遗址后来成为阿什哈巴德的一部分。公元前一至二世纪的记载已将其称为产葡萄酒的村庄。公元前一世纪的一场地震摧毁了聚落，但丝绸之路上的有利位置促使人们重建家园。孔吉卡拉此后繁荣发展，直到十三世纪遭蒙古人摧毁，随后以小村庄的形式延续。宏大的现代城市属于更晚的时代：阿什哈巴德于1881年以阿哈尔特克人的村落为基础建立，此时中世纪贸易聚落早已衰落。

english: Konkouré is a town in Guinea’s Mamou region. It also serves as a sub-prefecture within Mamou Prefecture.
simp_chinese: 孔库雷是几内亚马穆地区的一座城镇。它同时也是马穆省下辖的副省区。

english: Konkow country occupies a valley along the North Fork of the Feather River and its tributaries, between the places later called Cherokee and Pulga. The Konkow form one of the principal divisions of the Maidu peoples of northern California, whose communities identified with particular valleys, foothills and mountains. Among the Maidu, oak groves were carefully tended and fire helped maintain gathering grounds. Acorns were shelled, pounded and leached before becoming food, while salmon runs and other river fish supplied an important part of the diet. Basket makers transformed roots, bark and twigs into storage vessels, traps and finely patterned work. Villages remained politically small, with leaders principally settling disputes and negotiating relations between communities rather than ruling a centralized state.
simp_chinese: 孔考地区位于羽河北支及其支流沿岸的一条河谷中，处在后来称为切罗基和普尔加的两地之间。孔考人是北加利福尼亚迈杜人的主要分支之一；迈杜各群体往往以自己居住的河谷、山麓和山地来确认归属。迈杜人精心照料橡树林，并用火维护采集场所。橡实需经过剥壳、捣碎和浸滤才能食用，洄游的鲑鱼及其他河鱼也为饮食提供重要来源。编篮者将植物根、树皮和枝条制成储物容器、鱼陷与纹样精细的器物。各村落的政治规模较小，首领主要负责调解纠纷及协调村际关系，并不统辖一个集权国家。

english: Konkudera lies in the wider eastern Siberian country, whose southern reaches include extensive mountain ranges. These ranges form one part of a landscape otherwise dominated by the Central Siberian Plateau and northern tundra.
simp_chinese: 孔库杰拉位于更广阔的东西伯利亚地域，其南部有大片山脉。这些山脉是整个地区景观的一部分，而中部以中西伯利亚高原为主，北部则分布苔原。

english: Kono belongs to the Mande-speaking world of Upper Guinea. The wider Kono people trace their origins to migrations from Mali and Guinea, and their communities extended across the later boundary between Guinea and Sierra Leone.
simp_chinese: 科诺属于上几内亚的曼德语族世界。整个科诺族群将其源头追溯至来自马里与几内亚的迁徙，社群分布跨越了后来几内亚与塞拉利昂之间的边界。

english: The Konomala region lies on New Ireland in the Bismarck island world. Konomala is an Oceanic language, though many members of its community have shifted to Siar-Lak.
simp_chinese: 科诺马拉地区位于俾斯麦群岛世界中的新爱尔兰岛。科诺马拉语属于大洋洲语族，不过许多社群成员已改用西亚尔-拉克语。

english: Konrapa belongs to the wider Bolu country in northwestern Anatolia. The regional centre was known in antiquity as Bithynium and later Claudiopolis, and became a frontier town during the Byzantine struggle with westward-moving Turkish powers.
simp_chinese: 孔拉帕属于安纳托利亚西北部的博卢地区。其区域中心在古代称比提尼翁，后称克劳狄奥波利斯，在拜占庭与向西扩张的突厥势力争夺期间成为边境城镇。

english: Konski Vody belongs to Pryazovia, the country along the northern Sea of Azov. This is the southern margin of the East European Plain, where the Azov-Kuban Lowland meets the coastal zone and the Ukrainian Shield extends into the eastern part of the region.
simp_chinese: 孔斯基沃迪属于亚速海北岸的亚速海沿岸地域。这是东欧平原的南缘，亚速—库班低地在这里连接海岸带，乌克兰地盾则延伸至该地区东部。

english: The Konso country around Karati rises above the Sagan River in southwestern Ethiopia. Its steep slopes have been worked into stone-reinforced terraces, built to hold soil against irregular and sometimes heavy rain; maintaining them calls upon the labour of whole families. Hilltop settlements known as paletas are surrounded by concentric rings of basalt walls, enclosing compounds, granaries and communal meeting places called moras. Historical memory is also worked into the landscape. Generation stones mark the succession of age groups, while carved waga figures commemorate deceased people, their families and notable events in their lives. Sacred woodland holds ritual sites and the burials of ritual leaders, linking agriculture, settlement and remembrance across the hills.
simp_chinese: 埃塞俄比亚西南部卡拉蒂周围的孔索地区，高踞于萨甘河以北。人们将陡坡修筑为石墙加固的梯田，以抵御时断时续、有时又十分猛烈的雨水侵蚀；维护这些梯田需要全家共同劳动。称为paleta的山顶聚落被数重玄武岩石墙环绕，内部有家庭院落、粮仓和名为mora的公共集会场所。历史记忆也被刻入景观：世代纪念石记录年龄群体的更替，雕刻的waga木像纪念逝者、他们的家人与生前重要事件。神圣林地容纳仪式场所和祭仪领袖的墓葬，将农业、聚落与纪念传统联结在群山之间。

english: Konstantinovka lies in the Aidar river country of the Donets basin. The wider river is a left tributary of the Seversky Donets, flowing through a valley cut by ravines and gorges. Spring snowmelt provides most of its seasonal flow, while winter freezing begins in December.
simp_chinese: 康斯坦丁诺夫卡位于顿涅茨流域的阿依达尔河地区。更广阔的阿依达尔河是北顿涅茨河左岸支流，流经沟壑、峡谷切割的河谷。春季融雪贡献了大部分季节径流，十二月开始封冻。

english: Konstantinovsk stands on the Don near the Seversky Donets, within the country later administered as Rostov Oblast. Its geographical identity is tied to this meeting of the lower Don region's principal waterways. The modern town serves as the centre of a district that also embraces neighbouring rural settlements. Its formal town status dates only from 1967, a distinction much later than the earlier history of settlement along the Don.
simp_chinese: 康斯坦丁诺夫斯克坐落在顿河畔、北顿涅茨河附近，位于后来划归罗斯托夫州的地区。它的地理身份与顿河下游地区这些主要水道相会的位置紧密相连。现代城镇是一个包含周边乡村聚落的行政区中心。其正式城市地位直到1967年才获得，远晚于顿河沿岸更早的聚居历史。

english: Konstanz commands the place where the Rhine leaves Upper Lake Constance. Its bridge made it a strategic crossing in Swabia, while linen production brought the city an international reputation. A bishop had resided here since about 585, and in 1192 Konstanz became an Imperial City. The council held from 1414 to 1418 ended the Western Schism and elected Martin V; it also saw Jan Hus burned in 1415. The harbour building used for the conclave survives. After embracing the Reformation in the 1520s, the city lost its imperial independence to Habsburg Austria in 1548.
simp_chinese: 康斯坦茨扼守莱茵河流出博登湖上湖之处。桥梁使它成为施瓦本的重要渡口，亚麻织品生产则为城市赢得国际声誉。约自585年起，主教便驻于此地；1192年，康斯坦茨取得帝国城市地位。1414至1418年在此召开的宗教会议结束了教会大分裂，选出马丁五世；扬·胡斯也于1415年在会议期间被处以火刑。港边用于选举教宗的建筑至今留存。城市在1520年代接受宗教改革后，于1548年失去帝国直属地位，归入哈布斯堡奥地利统治。

english: The Kontagora River gives its name to this locality in the country south of Hausaland. The town now standing on its southern bank arose much later than the medieval period: Umaru Nagwamatse established it as his capital in 1864, after conquering extensive lands of the non-Muslim Kambari. The resulting emirate expanded under Umaru, while the slave raids of his successor Ibrahim brought severe depopulation and abandoned villages to the surrounding district. Ibrahim's capture of Birnin Gwari in 1899 drew British intervention after Zaria sought assistance. British forces occupied Kontagora in 1901, and his restoration as emir two years later came with greatly reduced authority. These nineteenth-century origins distinguish the later emirate's capital from the older inhabited country around the river.
simp_chinese: 孔塔戈拉河为豪萨地区以南的这片地方赋予了名称。如今坐落于南岸的城镇远晚于中世纪才兴起：乌马鲁·纳格瓦马采征服非穆斯林坎巴里人的大片土地后，于1864年在此建立都城。由此形成的酋长国在乌马鲁统治下扩张，而继任者易卜拉欣的掳奴行动则使周边地区人口锐减、村庄荒废。1899年，易卜拉欣攻占比尔宁瓜里，扎里亚求援，继而引来英国干预。英军于1901年占领孔塔戈拉；两年后易卜拉欣虽然复位，权力已受到很大限制。这些十九世纪的起源，使后来的酋长国都城与河流周围更古老的居民地区有所区别。

english: Kontcha is a town in Cameroon's Adamawa region. It also serves as the centre of the commune bearing its name.
simp_chinese: 孔查是喀麦隆阿达马瓦地区的一座城镇。它也是同名地方行政区的中心。

english: Kontrand’ya belongs to the Indigirka country of northeastern Siberia. The wider river lies between the Yana and Kolyma; seventeenth-century Russian explorers reached it by sea and by difficult overland routes across the northern mountain ranges.
simp_chinese: 康特朗德亚属于西伯利亚东北因迪吉尔卡地区。更广阔的河流位于亚纳河与科雷马河之间，17世纪俄罗斯探险者由海路和跨越北方山脉的艰难陆路抵达。

english: Konwargaon belongs to the Chutia homeland of Assam. The Chutia kingdom was absorbed by the Ahom in 1523–24, after which its people became dispersed across Upper and Central Assam.
simp_chinese: 康瓦尔冈属于阿萨姆的楚蒂亚人故土。楚蒂亚王国于1523至1524年被阿洪吞并，此后其人群散居于上阿萨姆和中阿萨姆。

english: Konyovo is a rural settlement in Russia's northern Arkhangelsk country. The locality belongs to the Plesetsk district, among the inland communities of the wider northern region.
simp_chinese: 科尼奥沃是俄罗斯北方阿尔汉格尔斯克地区的一处乡村聚落。它属于普列谢茨克辖区，是这一广阔北方地区的内陆社群之一。

english: Koo belongs to the inland Cape country associated with the Breede drainage. The wider river rises near the Skurweberg range, passes through mountain country toward Worcester and continues to an estuary at Witsand, gathering tributaries from the surrounding Cape ranges.
simp_chinese: 库位于开普内陆与布里德河流域相联系的地区。范围更大的布里德河发源于斯库尔韦山脉附近，穿越山地流向伍斯特，再通往维特桑德河口，汇集周边开普山脉的诸多支流。

english: Kooapudna belongs to the south-central Australian country. The wider South Australian region includes some of the continent’s driest lands, extending from southern coastal country toward the arid interior.
simp_chinese: 库阿普德纳属于澳大利亚中南部地区。更广阔的南澳地区包括大陆最干旱的一些土地，从南部沿海地域延伸至干旱内陆。

english: Koochiching belongs to the Rainy River country between northern Minnesota and northwestern Ontario. The river leaves Rainy Lake and flows toward Lake of the Woods. Its Ojibwe name and the traditional territory of the Couchiching First Nation preserve the Indigenous setting of these waters.
simp_chinese: 库奇钦属于明尼苏达北部与安大略西北之间雷尼河地区。河流从雷尼湖流出，通向伍兹湖。奥吉布瓦语名称及库奇钦第一民族的传统领地，保留了这些水域的原住民背景。

english: Kooinkill belongs to the Ngarkat country linking South Australia’s and Victoria’s mallee lands with the Murray River peoples. Songlines connected the Coorong and Mallee through this territory. Ngarkat communities also met regularly with neighbouring groups at gathering places along the Murray.
simp_chinese: 昆基尔属于恩加卡特地区，将南澳与维多利亚的桉灌林地同墨累河居民联系起来。歌路穿过这片领地，连接库龙与马利地区。恩加卡特社群也定期在墨累河沿岸聚会地点与邻近群体会面。

english: Koop Ticutta belongs to North America’s Great Basin country. The wider region covers much of Nevada and Utah, combining an arid climate with alternating basins and mountain ranges whose waters remain inland.
simp_chinese: 库普蒂库塔属于北美的大盆地地区。更广阔的地区覆盖内华达与犹他的大部分地方，气候干旱，盆地和山脉交错，水流留在内陆。

english: Koosharem occupies Utah's high Grass Valley, a meadow landscape near Fish Lake. Its name comes from a Paiute term associated with the deep red clover growing in the valley, preserving an Indigenous name beneath the later settlement. The modern town was established in 1877, long after the valley had acquired that name. At about 2,109 metres above sea level, it has a cold, semi-arid climate. Farming and livestock raising became enduring occupations here, while the surrounding valley provides habitat for sage grouse, prairie dogs, eagles and other wildlife of the upland country.
simp_chinese: 库沙雷姆位于犹他高处的草谷，是靠近菲什湖的一片草甸地带。其名称来自派尤特人的词语，与谷中生长的深红色三叶草相关，在后来的聚落之下保存着原住民地名。现代城镇于1877年建立，远晚于山谷获得这一名称的年代。这里海拔约2109米，气候寒冷而半干旱。耕作与畜牧成为长期延续的生计，周围谷地也为艾草松鸡、草原犬鼠、鹰类和其他高地动物提供栖息之处。

english: Koostaaka belongs to the Hidatsa country of the upper Missouri. Across this wider homeland, village communities lived around the Knife River for centuries; several related village groups with distinct histories later joined into the Hidatsa people.
simp_chinese: 库斯塔卡位于密苏里河上游的希达察地区。在这片广大故土，村落社群数百年来生活于奈夫河周边，多个历史不同、彼此相关的村群后来结合成希达察人。

english: Kopolque belongs to the wider Patagonian landscape at the southern end of South America. The region stretches between the Pacific and Atlantic oceans, combining southern Andean highlands with eastern steppe country.
simp_chinese: 科波尔克属于南美南端更广阔的巴塔哥尼亚地区。该地区横跨太平洋与大西洋之间，包括南安第斯高地及东部草原。

english: Koponovo belongs to the Ryazan country. The wider region centres on the Oka River, and Old Ryazan served as the principality’s capital until its destruction during the Mongol invasion of 1237.
simp_chinese: 科波诺沃属于梁赞地区。更广阔的区域以奥卡河为中心，旧梁赞曾为公国首都，直至1237年蒙古入侵时被摧毁。

english: Kopor'ye guarded the Baltic approaches to Novgorod, its fortress repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt as princes and townsmen contested its control. A wooden stronghold raised by the Teutonic Knights in 1240 was destroyed by Alexander Nevsky the following year. His son Dmitry built in stone in 1280, only for the Novgorodians to demolish it two years later; they restored the fort in 1297 as Swedish pressure increased. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the republic entrusted it to invited princes defending its northern lands. Despite its military importance and the ironworking district around it, the settlement had only eighteen households at the end of the fifteenth century. Muscovite rebuilding later adapted the walls to withstand cannon fire.
simp_chinese: 科波里耶守卫着通往诺夫哥罗德的波罗的海方向，其堡垒在诸侯与城邦居民争夺控制权的过程中屡次被毁重建。条顿骑士团于1240年修筑的木堡，次年便被亚历山大·涅夫斯基摧毁。他的儿子德米特里于1280年改筑石堡，诺夫哥罗德人却在两年后将其拆毁；随着瑞典压力加大，他们又于1297年恢复了要塞。十四至十五世纪，共和国数次将这里交给应邀防卫北方领土的诸侯。尽管军事地位重要，周围还有冶铁区，聚落在十五世纪末仍只有十八户人家。后来莫斯科的重建使城墙能够抵御火炮。

english: Koppal lies among hills in northern Karnataka, enclosed by higher ground on three sides. Earlier known as Kopana Nagara, it was associated with Jain religious life and remembered by the honorific Jaina Kashi, likening its sacred importance to that of Kashi. The fort, the Gavimath religious establishment and the Male Mallappa Temple represent different features of the town's surviving heritage. Together they give this inland settlement both a fortified and a devotional character. Its modern role as the headquarters of a separate Koppal district dates only from 1998, when that district was divided from Raichur; the older name and religious reputation belong to a much longer local past.
simp_chinese: 科帕尔位于卡纳塔克北部的丘陵之间，三面为高地环抱。它早先称作科帕纳纳加拉，与耆那教宗教生活联系深厚，并以“耆那教的迦尸”这一尊称为人所记忆，将其神圣地位与迦尸相提并论。城堡、加维马特宗教机构和马莱马拉帕神庙，呈现了当地遗产的不同侧面，使这处内陆聚落兼具设防城镇与礼拜中心的面貌。现代科帕尔县从赖久尔县分出，当地成为独立县治的行政身份仅始于1998年；其旧名与宗教声望则属于更为久远的地方历史。

english: Koppi belongs to the Tumnin country of the lower Amur region. Its broader northeastern Asian setting falls within historical Manchuria in the wide sense, extending from northeastern China into neighbouring Pacific territories.
simp_chinese: 都勒属于黑龙江下游区域的图姆宁地区。其更广阔的东北亚环境属于广义历史满洲，从中国东北延伸至相邻的太平洋地区。

english: Koppo belongs to the Ostrobothnian world of western Finland. South Ostrobothnia’s broader cultural area extends beyond its present administrative borders, and permanent settlement in the region dates to the Iron Age.
simp_chinese: 科珀属于芬兰西部的博滕地区。南博滕广义文化区域超出其今日行政边界，该地区的永久定居可追溯至铁器时代。

english: Koprivnica takes its name from a local stream, in country between the Drava to the north and the slopes of Bilogora and Kalnik to the south. First mentioned in 1272, it became a free royal town under Louis I in 1356, prospering through trade and crafts. Ottoman warfare gave this commercial settlement a second identity as a frontier fortress. Renaissance defenses built in the later sixteenth century made it a center of the Slavonian military border, with musketeers, hussars and infantry among its troops. A decree of Maria Theresa in 1765 allowed it to resume a more peaceful merchant life. Commerce subsequently spread beyond the fortifications, leaving spacious Baroque squares as a visible expression of the town's growing economy.
simp_chinese: 科普里夫尼察得名于当地一条溪流，北有德拉瓦河，南面则是比洛戈拉与卡尔尼克的山坡。这里首次见于1272年的记载，1356年在路易一世统治下成为自由王家城市，凭借贸易和手工业繁荣起来。对奥斯曼帝国的战争，又赋予这座商镇边疆要塞的身份。十六世纪后半叶修筑的文艺复兴式防御工事，使它成为斯拉沃尼亚军事边区的中心，驻军包括火枪手、骠骑兵和步兵。玛丽亚·特蕾莎1765年的敕令使其得以恢复较为和平的商镇生活。此后商业活动向城防以外扩展，宽阔的巴洛克广场成为城镇经济增长留下的印记。

english: Koptam belongs to the Uil river country of western Kazakhstan. Rising in the Mugodzhar Hills, the Uil crosses the steppe toward Lake Aktobe in the Caspian Depression, gathering many tributaries along its long inland course.
simp_chinese: 科普塔姆属于哈萨克斯坦西部的乌伊尔河地域。乌伊尔河发源于穆戈贾尔丘陵，穿越草原流向里海低地的阿克托别湖，在漫长的内陆河道上汇集众多支流。

english: Koptyuga belongs to the northern country associated with the White Sea and Northern Dvina. The wider regional centre at Arkhangelsk stands on the river’s delta. Medieval Scandinavian accounts knew this northern land as Bjarmaland, reflecting old contacts across the northern seas.
simp_chinese: 科普秋加属于与白海及北德维纳河相关的北方地区。广义地区中心阿尔汉格尔斯克位于河口三角洲。中世纪斯堪的纳维亚记述将北方土地称为比亚尔马兰，反映北方诸海之间的古老联系。

english:
Kopys is first recorded in 1059. From the fourteenth century it belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, and it received town rights during the sixteenth century. A private town of the Ostrogski family, it passed to the Radziwiłłs after 1594. Its castle and the Calvinist church founded by Krzysztof Mikołaj Radziwiłł reflected the authority and religious patronage of these magnates.

War and partition changed its fortunes. Russian troops destroyed Kopys in 1707 during the Great Northern War, and the First Partition of Poland brought it into the Russian Empire in 1772. By the end of the eighteenth century the town also possessed a Jewish printing establishment, adding a scholarly and commercial thread to its history of noble ownership.
simp_chinese:
科佩斯最早见于1059年的记载。十四世纪起，它属于立陶宛大公国，并在十六世纪获得城镇权。它曾是奥斯特罗格斯基家族的私有城镇，1594年以后转归拉齐维乌家族。城堡与克日什托夫·米科瓦伊·拉齐维乌建立的加尔文宗教堂，体现了大贵族的权势与宗教赞助。

战争与瓜分改变了它的命运。1707年大北方战争期间，俄军摧毁科佩斯；1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，它又被并入俄罗斯帝国。十八世纪末，城中还设有犹太印刷机构，在贵族领地的历史之外增添了一条学术与商业的线索。

english: Kopyshche belongs to the Olevsk country of Ukrainian Polissya. The wider regional centre is recorded from 1488 and received Magdeburg town rights from King Władysław IV in 1641, before later passing into the Russian Empire’s Volhynian administration.
simp_chinese: 科佩谢属于乌克兰波利西亚的奥列夫斯克地区。更广阔区域的中心自1488年见诸记录，1641年获国王瓦迪斯瓦夫四世授予马格德堡城市权，后来纳入俄罗斯帝国沃里尼亚行政体系。

english: Koraveka belongs to the tropical savanna country of Chiquitania. Across this wider region, Chiquitano, Gorgotoqui, Otuke, Ayoreo and Guarani languages were historically spoken, and eighteenth-century Jesuit and Franciscan settlements became prominent features of the landscape.
simp_chinese: 科拉维卡属于奇基塔尼亚的热带稀树草原地区。从更广区域看，历史上曾使用奇基塔诺、戈尔戈托基、奥图克、阿约雷奥与瓜拉尼等语言，18世纪的耶稣会和方济各会聚落成为当地显著景观。

english: Korbach prospered where the commercial roads from Cologne to Leipzig and Frankfurt to Bremen crossed the Waldeck plateau. Granted town rights under Soest law by the bishop of Paderborn in 1188, it expanded beyond its old core into a merchants' New Town. The two communities united in 1377, placing their common town hall on the former dividing line. A double circuit of walls was completed in 1414, and Korbach appears as a Hanseatic member in records of 1469. The nearby Eisenberg, despite its name of 'Iron Mountain', also yielded gold-bearing ore. Trade and mining did not protect the town from catastrophe: the Thirty Years' War sharply reduced its population, and the fire of 1664 destroyed almost all its houses, leaving the stone churches and warehouses among the strongest survivals of its medieval prosperity.
simp_chinese: 科尔巴赫坐落在瓦尔德克高原上，科隆至莱比锡、法兰克福至不来梅的商路在这里交汇。1188年，帕德博恩主教依索斯特法授予城镇权，此后商人聚居的新城逐渐扩展到旧城之外。1377年，两部分合并，将共同的市政厅建在原来的分界线上。双重城墙于1414年完工，1469年的文献已经将科尔巴赫列为汉萨同盟成员。附近的艾森山虽然名为“铁山”，也出产含金矿石。然而贸易与采矿无法让城镇免于灾难：三十年战争使人口锐减，1664年的大火又毁掉几乎所有民居，石造教堂与仓库成为中世纪繁荣时代最坚固的遗存。

english: The waters around Korčula belong to the island-rich eastern Adriatic. Channels among the Dalmatian islands form part of a long Mediterranean sea extending from the Po country towards Otranto.
simp_chinese: 科尔丘拉周围水域属于岛屿密布的亚得里亚海东部。达尔马提亚诸岛间水道，是从波河地区延伸至奥特朗托的绵长地中海支海的一部分。

english: Korea Bay opens into the northern Yellow Sea between the southeastern coast of Liaodong and the western shore of the Korean peninsula. The Liaodong Peninsula separates it from the Bohai Sea, with Lüshunkou at its western limit and the tip of Ryongyon on the Korean side marking the east. Three important rivers connect this expanse of water to the lands behind its shores. The Yalu, also called the Amnok, enters between Dandong and Sinuiju; farther along the Korean coast, the Chongchon reaches the bay at Sinanju and the Taedong at Nampo. These estuaries give the bay a geography shaped as much by river mouths as by the open sea.
simp_chinese: 朝鲜湾位于辽东东南岸与朝鲜半岛西岸之间，向南敞入黄海北部。辽东半岛将其与渤海隔开，西端以旅顺口为界，东端则抵达朝鲜龙渊一带的岬角。三条重要河流把这片海湾与岸后腹地联系起来。鸭绿江在丹东与新义州之间注入海湾；沿朝鲜西岸向前，清川江在新安州入海，大同江则在南浦汇入。这里的地理面貌由开阔海面与一连串河口共同塑造。

english: Korela was a Karelian stronghold contested by Novgorod and Sweden, first appearing in a Novgorodian chronicle under the year 1143. In 1314 a Karelian force expelled Novgorod's representatives and invited Swedish help, but Novgorod recovered the fortress; the Treaty of Nöteborg confirmed its possession in 1323. After fire destroyed the wooden works in 1360, stone towers and defences followed in 1364. Sweden seized Korela in 1580 and reshaped it with western-style bastions. Returned to Russia in 1597, it passed back to Sweden during the Ingrian War and became part of Kexholm County under the 1617 Treaty of Stolbovo. Peter the Great captured it during the Great Northern War, and the fortress later served as an imperial political prison.
simp_chinese: 科雷拉原是卡累利阿人的要塞，长期成为诺夫哥罗德与瑞典争夺的据点，1143年的诺夫哥罗德编年史已记载其名。1314年，卡累利阿部队驱逐诺夫哥罗德的代表并邀请瑞典援守，但诺夫哥罗德重新夺回要塞，1323年《涅特堡条约》确认了它的归属。1360年木制防御工事毁于火灾，1364年随后修筑石塔与城防。瑞典于1580年攻占科雷拉，并按西欧式样改建棱堡。1597年交还俄国后，它又在英格里亚战争期间落入瑞典之手，并依1617年《斯托尔博沃条约》纳入凯克斯霍尔姆领地。彼得大帝在大北方战争中夺取此处，堡垒后来又被用作帝国的政治监狱。

english: Korenevo is a village in Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. It belongs to the Mezhdurechensky rural administrative area of Sokolsky District.
simp_chinese: 科列涅沃是下诺夫哥罗德州的一座村庄，隶属索科利斯基区的梅日杜列琴斯基乡级行政区。

english:
On the Korchyk River east of Rivne, Korets was known as Korchesk by 1150. Prince Theodor Ostrogski fortified it in the late fourteenth century, when it belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its castle subsequently became the seat of the princely House of Korets, and after the last Prince Korecki died in 1651 it passed by inheritance to a younger branch of the Czartoryski family.

The Union of Lublin brought the town into the Polish Crown in 1569. Noble patronage later gave it an unusual industrial distinction: Jozef Klemens Czartoryski founded a porcelain factory in 1783, managed by the French brothers Francois and Michel de Mezer. Its wares became known across Poland. Fire destroyed the works in 1797, but production resumed after rebuilding in 1800 and continued until 1832. Cloth sashes of the kind worn by the Polish-Lithuanian nobility were also manufactured here.
simp_chinese:
科雷茨位于罗夫诺以东的科尔奇克河畔，1150年已以科尔切斯克之名见于记载。14世纪末，当这里属于立陶宛大公国时，费奥多尔·奥斯特罗格斯基公爵为其修筑防御。城堡后来成为科雷茨公爵家族的驻地；最后一位科雷茨基公爵于1651年去世后，城堡由恰尔托雷斯基家族的一个支系继承。

1569年的卢布林联合使城镇划入波兰王冠领地。贵族的扶持后来赋予这里一种独特的工业声名：约瑟夫·克莱门斯·恰尔托雷斯基于1783年创办瓷器厂，由法国的弗朗索瓦与米歇尔·德梅泽兄弟经营，产品闻名波兰各地。1797年的火灾烧毁工厂，1800年重建后恢复生产，一直经营到1832年。波兰立陶宛贵族佩戴的织物腰带，也曾在这里制造。

english: Korgan belongs to the broader Dasht-i Kipchak, the Steppe of the Kipchaks. Across this region, Cuman and Kipchak nomadic groups formed a powerful confederation between the tenth and thirteenth centuries. Its Latin name, Cumania, also survived in later descriptions of the Golden Horde.
simp_chinese: 科尔甘属于广义的Dasht-i Kipchak，即钦察草原。十至十三世纪，库曼与钦察游牧群体在这片区域形成强大联盟。其拉丁语名称Cumania也保留于后来对金帐汗国的描述中。

english: Korhogo stands in the savanna country of northern Ivory Coast and has long been a principal centre of the Senufo people. Before colonial rule it lay on an important trading route towards the Atlantic coast. Its surrounding economy has produced cotton and kapok alongside rice, millet, yams and livestock, while a woodcarvers' quarter reflects another local craft tradition. Mont-Korhogo rises over the southwestern quarter of the settlement. In the late nineteenth century Chief Gbon Coulibaly used diplomacy to preserve the town from destruction during the advances of Samory Touré and the French.
simp_chinese: 科霍戈位于科特迪瓦北部的稀树草原地区，长期以来都是塞努福人的主要中心。殖民统治以前，它坐落在通向大西洋海岸的重要商路上。周边地区生产棉花与木棉纤维，也出产稻米、小米、山药和牲畜；木雕匠聚居的街区则体现了当地另一项手工艺传统。科霍戈山俯临聚落的西南部。十九世纪末，酋长格邦·库利巴利凭借外交手段，使城镇在萨莫里·杜尔与法国势力推进期间免遭毁灭。

english: Kori Bara Karaa Ancas belongs to the Qullaw plateau country of the central Andes. The wider Altiplano lies chiefly in Bolivia and Peru, with inland drainage, Lake Titicaca in the north and arid salt flats farther south; humid northeastern lands contrast with the drier southwest.
simp_chinese: 科里巴拉卡拉安卡斯属于安第斯中部库利亚弗高原地区。更广阔的阿尔蒂普拉诺主要位于玻利维亚与秘鲁，水流多内流，北有的的喀喀湖，南方较干旱且有盐滩，东北湿润土地与干燕西南部形成差异。
